summary: 水温影响香气释放、苦涩与汤感，是冲泡中最容易调整的变量之一。先固定茶水比和时间，再单独改变水温，才能判断差异。

title: Water temperature
summary: Water temperature changes how quickly aroma, sweetness and bitterness are extracted. It is one of the easiest variables to adjust, but it should be changed together with leaf ratio and infusion time.

title: 黄金桂
summary: 以黄旦（黄棪）品种鲜叶制成的乌龙茶，原产安溪虎邱罗岩。发芽早、香气高，有“一早二奇”和“透天香”之称。

title: Huangjin Gui
summary: An Anxi oolong made from the Huangdan (Huangyan) cultivar, native to Luoyan, Huqiu. It is early-ripening and high-aroma, known as “one early, two unusual” and “sky-piercing fragrance”.

title: 金萱
summary: 台湾茶业改良场育成的台茶12号，1981 年命名，试验代号 2027，俗称“27仔”。适制包种与乌龙，天然奶香并非每一批都有。

title: Jin Xuan
summary: Taiwan Tea No. 12, bred at the Tea Research and Extension Station and named in 1981. Known as “27仔” from its experimental code. Suitable for pouchong and oolong; natural milky aroma is not present in every batch.

title: 梅占
summary: 原产安溪芦田三洋村的无性系茶树品种，树姿直立、节间长，俗称“高脚乌龙”。适制乌龙、红、绿、白茶，是安溪六大传统名茶之一。

title: Meizhan
summary: A clonal cultivar from Sanyang village, Lutian, Anxi. Its upright habit and long internodes give it the nickname “high-legged oolong”. It can be made into oolong, black, green and white tea.

title: 政和大白茶
summary: 原产福建政和铁山镇的无性系茶树品种，晚生、芽壮、茸毛多，适制白茶、红茶与绿茶。它和福鼎大白茶不是同一个品种。

title: Zhenghe Dabaicha
summary: A clonal tea cultivar from Tieshan, Zhenghe, Fujian. Late-ripening, large-leaf and hairy, suitable for white, black and green tea. It is not the same cultivar as Fuding Dabaicha.

title: 氨基酸与鲜味
summary: 茶的鲜味来自游离氨基酸与多酚、咖啡因、糖类的平衡，不是“味精味”。L-茶氨酸是主要角色之一，但一杯茶的鲜感是混合物、品种、遮阴与冲泡共同的结果。

title: Amino Acids and Umami
summary: Tea umami comes from free amino acids balanced against polyphenols, caffeine and sugars — not from a “MSG taste”. L-theanine is one important player, but the freshness of a cup is a product of the mixture, cultivar, shading and brewing.

title: 抗氧化宣称
summary: 试管里能清除自由基，不等于喝下去能保护人体细胞。EFSA 明确区分“食品在模型体系中的自由基清除能力”与“已被证实的人体健康效果”；ORAC 等体外指标不能单独支撑健康宣称。

title: Oxidation Claims
summary: Scavenging free radicals in a test tube does not mean protecting human cells after drinking. EFSA separates “radical-scavenging capacity in a model system” from “a substantiated human health effect”; ORAC and similar in vitro indices cannot stand alone.

title: 冲泡问题排查
summary: 茶不好喝，先别怪茶叶。苦涩、寡淡、浑浊、没香气、酸馊，通常能对应到水温、茶水比、时间、水质、器具或仓储中的某个变量。按症状排查，比盲目换茶更快。

title: Brewing Troubleshooting
summary: When tea tastes wrong, the leaf is not always to blame. Bitterness, thinness, cloudiness, lost aroma, sourness and mustiness usually map to water, temperature, leaf ratio, time, vessel or storage. Work symptom by symptom.

title: 冲泡的基本变量
summary: 水温、茶水比、时间、器具与水质如何影响一杯茶，以及怎样用单变量对比找到自己的参数。

title: The variables of brewing
summary: How water temperature, leaf-to-water ratio, time, vessel and water quality shape a cup, and how to find your own numbers through one-variable comparisons.

title: 一杯茶有多少咖啡因
summary: 一杯茶的咖啡因不是一个固定数字，而是“投茶量 × 茶叶咖啡因含量 × 浸出率”的结果。茶类、嫩度、碎度、水温、时间与第几泡都会改变它；估算比背一张表更有用。

title: Caffeine in a Cup
summary: Caffeine in a cup is not a fixed number. It is leaf amount × caffeine content × extraction rate, then modified by tea type, leaf grade, water temperature, time and infusion number. An estimate is more useful than memorising a table.

title: 咖啡因安全边界
summary: 咖啡因的安全不是一句“适量”，而是几条按人群分开的剂量线：健康成人、孕期、儿童与敏感人群各不相同。茶只是来源之一，杯子大小和浸泡时间都会改变实际摄入。

title: Caffeine Safety
summary: Caffeine safety is not one “moderate” line. It is several dose lines split by population—healthy adults, pregnancy, children and sensitive people. Tea is only one source, and cup size and steep time change the dose.

title: 咖啡因
summary: 茶里的咖啡因先是一个剂量问题，而不是茶类标签。按杯型、投茶量、叶片形态与冲泡时间估算，再把 EFSA、FDA 与孕期边界分开看。

title: Caffeine
summary: Caffeine in tea is a dose question before it is a tea-type question. Estimate the cup from serving size, leaf quantity, leaf form and steeping time, then keep the EFSA, FDA and pregnancy boundaries separate.

title: 儿茶素
summary: 儿茶素是绿茶里最受关注的一类多酚。EGCG 约占总量的一半到七成，涩感来自它与唾液蛋白的相互作用；工艺会把同一组分子氧化成茶黄素与茶红素，健康宣称则要回到剂量与证据。

title: Catechins
summary: Catechins are the polyphenols most closely associated with green tea. EGCG makes up roughly half to 70% of the total; astringency comes from its interaction with salivary proteins; processing oxidises the same molecules into theaflavins and thearubigins; health claims must return to dose and evidence.

title: 茶中的氟
summary: 茶树会从土壤吸收氟，老叶与砖茶的氟含量通常高于嫩芽茶。风险不在“茶里有氟”，而在长期大量饮用高氟砖茶、再加上饮水与其他来源的总摄入。

title: Fluoride in Tea
summary: Tea plants take fluoride from the soil, and mature leaves and brick tea usually contain more than young-leaf tea. The risk is not “fluoride exists in tea”, but long-term large-volume drinking of high-fluoride brick tea combined with water and other sources.

title: 茶中的重金属
summary: 铅、镉、砷、铝等元素在茶中可以被检出，但“检出”不等于“危害”。来源、叶龄、工艺、冲泡方式与摄入量共同决定暴露；茶汤与茶粉/抹茶的风险也不是一回事。

title: Heavy Metals in Tea
summary: Lead, cadmium, arsenic and aluminium can be detected in tea, but detection is not the same as harm. Source, leaf age, processing, brewing and intake decide exposure; brew and whole-leaf powder are not the same risk.

title: L-茶氨酸
summary: 茶氨酸是茶叶里特有的游离氨基酸，参与鲜味、甜感与汤感。它能穿过血脑屏障，但“放松”“助眠”“提升专注”的人体证据并不一致，不能把一杯茶直接等同于补充剂结论。

title: L-Theanine
summary: L-theanine is a non-protein amino acid characteristic of tea and contributes to umami, sweetness and body. It crosses the blood-brain barrier, but human evidence for relaxation, sleep and focus is inconsistent; a cup of tea cannot be equated with a supplement dose.

title: 茶中的微生物
summary: 干茶不是无菌食品。芽孢杆菌、曲霉、青霉与酵母在加工和仓储中很常见；多数检出不对应疾病，但潮湿贮藏会让霉菌与毒素风险上升。关键不是“有没有菌”，而是“什么菌、多少、茶是否受潮”。

title: Microbes in Tea

summary: 茶黄素是红茶发酵中儿茶素氧化缩合形成的橙红色多酚，影响茶汤亮度、浓度与部分涩感。看发酵窗口与杯中的比例，不要把它当成单一“健康卖点”。

title: Theaflavins

title: Water and Extraction
summary: Temperature, time, leaf-to-water ratio and water mineralisation together determine the strength and flavour of a cup. Hotter water extracts faster, hard water can flatten aroma and darken liquor, but “purer is better” is not the answer either.

title: Ageing Pu-erh
summary: Pu-erh ageing depends on stable temperature and humidity, some airflow and a clean, odour-free environment. Older is not automatically better; raw material, processing and storage determine the result.

title: 马黛煮茶（Mate Cocido）
summary: Mate cocido 是把马黛茶用沸水冲泡或短时间煮、再过滤到杯子里喝的饮法，类似茶包茶。它比葫芦杯热饮更浓、更苦，常加糖、牛奶或柠檬，是阿根廷家庭、学校、医院和咖啡馆的日常饮品。

title: Mate Cocido
summary: Mate cocido is yerba mate infused with boiling water and strained into a cup, like tea. It is stronger and more bitter than gourd mate, easy to sweeten or take with milk, and is the everyday form found in Argentine homes, schools, hospitals and cafés.

title: 带梗马黛茶
summary: “Con palo”是带梗马黛茶。它把干燥叶片与一定比例的嫩茎、碎片混合，口感通常比去梗更圆润、更甜、刺激感更低。阿根廷地理标志对带梗产品有明确比例：叶片不少于 65%，茎梗和纤维不超过 35%。

title: Yerba Mate with Stems
summary: “Con palo” is stemmed yerba mate: dried leaf blended with a controlled share of young stems. The stems soften the cup, add a woody sweetness and keep the bombilla drawing evenly. Argentina’s geographical indication caps stems at 35% and requires at least 65% leaf.

title: 阿根廷有机马黛茶
summary: 有机马黛茶不是新植物品种，而是按阿根廷有机农业法规种植、采收、加工并经过第三方认证的 Ilex paraguariensis 产品。核心差异在土壤管理、禁用合成农药化肥、缓冲带、可追溯记录和认证标志，不在“有机就一定更好喝”。

title: Organic Argentine Yerba Mate
summary: Organic yerba mate is the same Ilex paraguariensis leaf grown, processed and packed under Argentina’s organic law and certified by an authorised third party. The difference is the production system — soil management, banned synthetic inputs, buffer zones and traceability — not a guarantee of a better-tasting cup.

title: 阿根廷冰马黛（Tereré）
summary: Tereré 是用冷水或冰水冲泡马黛茶的饮法，在阿根廷东北部、巴拉圭和巴西南部都很常见。它和热饮马黛使用同一原料，但水温、器具和添加物不同；阿根廷做法常加冰块、柑橘、薄荷或果汁，茶味比热饮更清、更淡。

title: Argentine Tereré
summary: Tereré is yerba mate brewed with cold water and ice. It uses the same leaf and often the same bombilla as hot mate, but the lower temperature gives a lighter, sweeter, less bitter drink. In Argentina it is a summer habit, not a separate tea plant.

title: 马黛茶
summary: 马黛茶是用冬青科植物 Ilex paraguariensis 的叶和嫩茎制成的南美传统饮品，不是山茶属茶。阿根廷把它称为“国民饮品”，主要产区在米西奥内斯和科连特斯。传统有热饮马黛、冰饮 tereré 和煮饮 mate cocido 三种形式，共用一个葫芦杯和金属吸管。

title: Yerba Mate
summary: Yerba mate is an infusion of Ilex paraguariensis, a South American holly, not a Camellia sinensis tea. Argentina calls it the national infusion and grows most of it in Misiones and Corrientes. The same leaf is drunk hot from a gourd, cold as tereré, or boiled and strained as mate cocido.

title: 里贝拉谷红茶
summary: 里贝拉谷红茶是巴西圣保罗州南部里贝拉河谷的红茶生产传统，核心在 Registro、Pariquera-Açu 与 Sete Barras 一带；它不是单一品牌、单一品种或统一工艺。1913 年 Torazo Okamoto 从斯里兰卡带回阿萨姆茶苗，1930 年代日本移民把茶园扩展到约 5,000 公顷、600 户生产者、约 40 家加工厂，九成出口；1980 年代危机后大量工厂关闭。1984 年州法授予 Registro“州茶都”称号，1997–2023 年该市茶叶出口额超过 6,800 万美元。当前可核实的生产路径包括 Amaya 的非正统工艺与大宗出口、Sítio Shimada 的有机手工红茶、Sítio Yamamaru 的农林复合小批次茶。公开材料没有全产区统一的品种、工艺或感官标准，不能用一个“CTC 浓强”概括整个河谷。

title: Vale do Ribeira Black Tea
summary: Vale do Ribeira black tea is a regional black-tea tradition in southern São Paulo state, centred on Registro, Pariquera-Açu and Sete Barras. It is not a single brand, cultivar or standardized process. In 1913 Torazo Okamoto brought Assam seedlings from Sri Lanka; in the 1930s Japanese immigrant growers expanded the valley to about 5,000 ha, 600 producers and 40 factories, with roughly 90% exported. The 1980s crisis closed many factories. A 1984 state law gave Registro the title “State Tea Capital”, and the city exported more than US$68 million of tea between 1997 and 2023. Three current cases are Amaya's non-orthodox, export-oriented production; Sítio Shimada's organic handmade black tea; and Sítio Yamamaru's agroforestry smallholding. Public sources do not give one regional cultivar, process or sensory standard, so “CTC strong liquor” is not a safe description of the whole valley.

title: 加拿大北方针叶草本茶（Labrador Tea 与云杉尖）
summary: 加拿大北方针叶草本茶不是一种固定的加拿大“国家茶”，也不是 Camellia sinensis 茶，而是一类用加拿大北方森林植物做的无咖啡因 infusion。最常见的是拉布拉多茶（Labrador tea，Rhododendron groenlandicum / R. tomentosum）和云杉春季嫩尖（Picea glauca / P. mariana），也会用香脂冷杉、松树等。它有原住民与欧洲移民的长期饮用传统，但拉布拉多茶含 ledol 与 grayanotoxins，过量或不当制备有风险，不能当“排毒茶”或药物替代品。

title: Canadian Boreal Herbal Tea
titleAlt: 加拿大北方针叶草本茶（Labrador Tea 与云杉尖）
summary: Canadian boreal herbal tea is not a fixed national recipe and not Camellia sinensis tea. It is a working label for caffeine-free infusions made from plants of Canada's boreal forest, most commonly Labrador tea (Rhododendron groenlandicum / R. tomentosum) and spring spruce tips (Picea glauca / P. mariana), with balsam fir and pine sometimes added. It has a long Indigenous and settler drinking tradition, but Labrador tea contains ledol and grayanotoxins; excessive or badly prepared infusions carry real risk. It is not a detox tea and not a substitute for medicine.

title: 加拿大冰酒风味茶（Canadian Icewine Tea）
summary: 冰酒茶（Canadian Icewine Tea）是加拿大市场常见的冰酒风味红茶拼配，不是冰酒，也不是在加拿大茶园里种植的茶。它通常以斯里兰卡等产地的红茶为底，加入冰酒、天然香料或冰酒风味；不同品牌的配方差别很大，有的含真实冰酒，有的只含葡萄风味香料。安大略冰酒本身受 VQA 规则约束：葡萄须在藤上自然冻结、-8°C 以下采摘并立即压榨，果汁至少 35 Brix。冰酒茶借用这套风味语言，但“茶底产地”“冰酒含量”“是否含酒精”要分开看。旧稿把它写成加拿大本地茶园、单一尼亚加拉产地和固定大吉岭/福鼎拼配，这些说法没有来源，已改写。

title: Canadian Icewine Tea (Icewine-Flavoured Black Tea)
titleAlt: 加拿大冰酒风味茶（Canadian Icewine Tea）
summary: Canadian Icewine Tea is a flavoured black-tea blend sold in Canada, not icewine and not tea grown in a Canadian garden. The base is usually Sri Lankan or other black tea, combined with icewine, natural flavours or grape flavour; formulations vary, and some contain real Ontario icewine while others use flavour only. Ontario Icewine itself is regulated: grapes must be naturally frozen on the vine, picked at -8°C or lower and pressed immediately, with juice at least 35 Brix. The old draft's claims of a Canadian tea garden, a single Niagara origin and fixed Darjeeling/Fuding bases had no source and have been rewritten.

title: JusTea 加拿大枫糖红茶（Canadian Maple）
summary: JusTea Canadian Maple 是加拿大温哥华茶企 JusTea 的一款枫糖风味红茶，用肯尼亚雨林联盟认证红茶做底，加入魁北克真实枫糖片、红花花瓣和天然枫糖风味，不是用人工枫糖香精调出来的“糖味茶”。官方建议 1 茶匙、175°F（约 79°C）热水、泡 3 分钟，每杯约 50 毫克咖啡因，可热饮、冰饮或加奶。旧稿的“加拿大最经典本土茶品”“1980–90 年代多伦多/蒙特利尔茶商首创”“2017 Canada 150 限定版”都没有来源，已删除。

title: JusTea Canadian Maple Tea
titleAlt: JusTea 加拿大枫糖红茶（Canadian Maple）
summary: JusTea Canadian Maple is a maple-flavoured black tea from JusTea, a Vancouver tea company. Its base is Rainforest Alliance-certified Kenyan black tea, blended with real Quebec maple syrup flakes, safflower petals and natural maple flavour. The point is that the maple is real: the blend uses maple flakes rather than an artificial maple extract, and the official brewing advice is one teaspoon, 175°F water, three minutes, about 50 mg caffeine per cup, hot, iced or with milk. The old draft's claims about Canada's “most classic” maple tea, a 1980s Toronto or Montreal origin story and a 2017 Canada 150 edition have no source and are gone.

title: 六安瓜片
summary: 六安瓜片是安徽大别山一带的片型绿茶，地理标志产品。它以单片叶为原料，无芽无梗，形似瓜子，色泽宝绿上霜；经摊凉、生锅、熟锅、毛火、小火、摊放、拉老火等工序制成。栗香或花香高长，滋味鲜爽醇厚。

title: Lu'an Guapian
summary: Lu'an Guapian is a flat, melon-seed-shaped green tea from the Dabie Mountains of Anhui, and a geographical-indication product. It is unusual among famous Chinese greens for using a single mature leaf with no bud and no stem. The leaf is pan-fixed, shaped, baked and finished with repeated charcoal “old-fire” passes, giving a chestnut or floral aroma and a thick, sweet cup.

title: 黄山贡菊茶
summary: 黄山贡菊茶是徽州贡菊与黄山烘青绿茶的完美融合——将徽州两大名品巧妙结合的花茶艺术杰作。以黄山烘青绿茶为基茶，与徽州贡菊（中国四大名菊之一，与杭白菊、滁菊、亳菊齐名）经窨制工艺融合。冲泡后整朵贡菊花在杯中徐徐绽放，茶汤黄绿明亮，菊香清雅高逸、凉意沁人，滋味甘甜清凉——贡菊的天然甘甜无需加糖。

title: Huangshan Gongju Chrysanthemum Tea
summary: Huangshan Gongju Chrysanthemum Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 黄山毛峰
summary: 黄山毛峰是安徽黄山的烘青绿茶，地理标志产品。以黄山种、祁门种、滴水香、茗洲种等地方良种芽叶为原料，经摊青、杀青、做形、毛火、足火制成。外形微卷似雀舌，象牙黄绿，白毫显露；香气清高，滋味鲜爽回甘。

title: Huangshan Maofeng
summary: Huangshan Maofeng is a baked green tea from Huangshan, Anhui, and a geographical-indication product. It is made from the buds and leaves of local cultivars such as Huangshan cultivar, Qimen cultivar, Dishuixiang and Mingzhou cultivar, through withering, fixing, shaping, first baking and final baking. The leaf is slightly curled like a sparrow tongue, ivory-green and downy; the cup is fresh, fragrant and sweet.

title: 霍山黄芽
summary: 霍山黄芽是安徽霍山的黄芽茶，以细嫩芽叶和闷黄工艺为特点。干茶挺直微展，汤色黄绿至杏黄，香气以甜香、栗香为主；它属于黄茶，不是绿茶，也不能用“黄金芽”等品种名替代。

title: Huoshan Huangya
summary: Huoshan Huangya is a yellow bud tea from Huoshan, Anhui, made from fine young leaves and yellowed through menhuang. It has a straight, slightly open shape and a yellow-green to apricot liquor with sweet, chestnut-like aromas; it is not a green tea, and “Huangjinya” cultivar names are not the same product.

title: 金山绿茶（金山时雨）
summary: 金山绿茶通常指安徽绩溪的历史名茶“金山时雨”，核心产区在上庄镇金山村，海拔约 500–900 米，因条索紧细如雨丝、采于谷雨前后得名。2010 年获农产品地理标志登记，2025 年获国家地理标志产品认定。旧机器稿把它写成泰国拜县的华人村绿茶，并编出“段老兵”故事；这些说法没有可靠来源，本站已改回安徽绩溪。

title: Jinshan Green Tea (Jinshan Shiyu)
summary: Jinshan green tea usually refers to Jinshan Shiyu, a historical green tea from Jixi county in Anhui, China. Its core village sits at about 500–900 m, and the tea is picked around Guyu, when the tightly rolled strips are said to resemble rain threads. It received national geographical indication product recognition in 2025. The old machine draft placed it in a Chinese village in Pai, Thailand, and invented a “Veteran Duan” origin story; that claim has no reliable source and has been corrected.

title: 祁门红茶
summary: 祁门红茶是安徽祁门一带的工夫红茶，以“祁门香”著称，香气常被描述为花香、果香和蜜糖香的复合。按 GB/T 13738.2-2017，它属于工夫红茶；具体产地、等级和地理标志使用资格应看包装与标准。

title: Keemun black tea
summary: Keemun is a congou black tea from the Qimen area of Anhui, known for “Keemun aroma”, often described as a mix of floral, fruity and honey notes. Under GB/T 13738.2-2017 it is a congou black tea; origin, grade and GI status should be checked on the label.

title: 太平猴魁
summary: 太平猴魁是黄山太平一带的烘青绿茶，地理标志产品。以柿大茶为主，采一芽二叶，经拣尖、摊放、杀青、整形、烘焙制成。外形扁平挺直、魁伟重实，两叶抱一芽，色泽苍绿；兰香高爽，滋味甘醇。它是绿茶里少见的“大叶”风格。

title: Taiping Houkui
summary: Taiping Houkui is a baked green tea from the Taiping area of Huangshan, Anhui, and a geographical-indication product. It is made mainly from the Shidacha cultivar, picked as one bud and two leaves, then sorted, withered, fixed, shaped and baked. The leaf is large, flat and upright, with two leaves holding one bud; the cup is orchid-fragrant, fresh and sweet.

title: 白毫银针
summary: 白毫银针是以单芽制成的白茶，芽头肥壮、满披白毫，汤色浅杏，清甜鲜爽；按白茶国家标准属于白毫银针品类，产地、品种和工艺共同影响其风格。

title: Baihao Yinzhen (Silver Needle)
summary: Baihao Yinzhen is a white tea made from single buds, with plump, downy needles and a pale apricot liquor. The white-tea national standard defines it as a distinct category; origin, cultivar and processing shape its style.

title: 白芽奇兰
summary: 白芽奇兰是闽南乌龙茶的后起之秀，也是平和县最具特色的乌龙茶品种，有"平和第一茶"之称。因茶芽白毫显露如银、香气奇绝似幽兰而得名——"奇兰"之"奇"在于其兰花香气之奇特高扬难以复制。外形紧结匀整，色泽砂绿油润。冲泡后兰花香清雅高扬扑鼻而来，香气奇绝，汤色金黄明亮，滋味醇厚甘爽。

title: Baiya Qilan Oolong
summary: Baiya Qilan Oolong is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 大红袍
summary: 大红袍是武夷岩茶的代表性产品名，现行 GB/T 18745-2006 将武夷岩茶分为大红袍、水仙、肉桂、名丛、奇种五类。市售大红袍多为多品种拼配；九龙窠母树受保护，不作为商品茶采摘。

title: Da Hong Pao
summary: Da Hong Pao is a flagship Wuyi rock-tea product name. GB/T 18745-2006 groups Wuyi rock tea into Da Hong Pao, Shuixian, Rougui, Mingcong and Qizhong; commercial Da Hong Pao is usually a blend, and the mother trees are protected rather than picked for sale.

title: 福鼎白牡丹
summary: 福鼎白牡丹是以一芽一、二叶制成的白茶，芽叶连枝、绿叶夹银白毫心，汤色杏黄，毫香与花香并见。按 GB/T 22291-2017，白牡丹的原料嫩度介于白毫银针与贡眉、寿眉之间；福鼎是主要产区之一。

title: Fuding Bai Mudan
summary: Fuding Bai Mudan is a white tea made from one bud and one or two leaves, with attached bud and leaf, a silver-white bud among green leaves and an apricot-yellow liquor. Under GB/T 22291-2017 it sits between Baihao Yinzhen and Gongmei/Shoumei in raw-material tenderness.

title: 福鼎贡眉
summary: 贡眉是按白茶国家标准以群体种茶树嫩梢制成的白茶，原料嫩度通常低于白牡丹、高于寿眉。它常带有更复合的花香和甜感；因群体种茶园减少，传统贡眉的原料基础已比过去少见。

title: Fuding Gongmei
summary: Gongmei is a white tea made under the national standard from the young shoots of population cultivars, usually less tender than Bai Mudan and more tender than Shoumei. It often has a more complex floral and sweet character; population gardens are now less common than in the past.

title: 福鼎老白茶
summary: 福鼎老白茶是经多年自然陈化的白茶，是时间和自然的共同杰作。新白茶清鲜微甜如素颜少女，陈化3年后转为蜜甜带枣香如成熟少妇，陈化7年以上产生药香和参香如睿智长者——"一年茶、三年药、七年宝"正是白茶陈化的生命哲学。老白茶可泡可煮——泡之则枣香药香层层绽放，煮之则满室生香汤如琥珀。从杏黄逐年加深至琥珀色乃至酒红色，老白茶的汤色是时间的年轮。

title: Fuding Aged White Tea
summary: Fuding Aged White Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 福鼎寿眉
summary: 福鼎寿眉是以较成熟芽叶制成的白茶，常见一芽二、三叶甚至更粗老的原料。它汤色较深、滋味醇和，适合日常饮用和陈放，但“越老越好”不成立，仓储与原料才是关键。

title: Fuding Shoumei
summary: Fuding Shoumei is a white tea made from relatively mature buds and leaves, often one bud with two or three leaves or coarser material. It has a deeper colour and mellow taste, suits daily drinking and ageing, but “older is better” is not a fact; storage and material matter.

title: 清香型铁观音
summary: 清香型铁观音是安溪铁观音三大产品类型之一（另为浓香型、陈香型）。它以铁观音品种芽叶为原料，经萎凋、做青、杀青、揉捻、包揉、烘干制成毛茶，再经拣剔、筛分、拼配、文火烘干精制。条索紧结砂绿，汤色金黄明亮，香气清高，滋味鲜醇甘爽，音韵明显。

title: Light-Aroma Tieguanyin
summary: Light-aroma Tieguanyin is one of the three product types of Anxi Tieguanyin, alongside roasted and aged styles. It is made from the Tieguanyin cultivar through withering, shaking, fixing, rolling, wrap-rolling and drying, then sorted, blended and given a low-temperature “literary fire” dry. The leaf is tight and sandy-green, the liquor golden, the aroma clear and orchid-like, and the taste fresh, sweet and distinctly “yin-rhymed”.

title: 福鼎白琳工夫
summary: 白琳工夫是"闽红三大工夫"之一(与坦洋工夫、政和工夫齐名),产于福鼎白琳镇——福鼎白茶的故乡。以福鼎大白茶品种制作工夫红茶,香气兼具白茶的清雅和红茶的蜜甜——"白茶基因中的红茶风味",这在红茶世界中独一无二。外形紧细秀丽匀整,色泽乌润金毫显露。冲泡后蜜甜花香交织缠绵——蜜甜的底韵中透出白茶品种特有的清雅毫香。

title: Fuding Bailin Gongfu Black Tea (Fujian)
summary: Fuding Bailin Gongfu Black Tea (Fujian) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 武夷水金龟
summary: 水金龟是武夷岩茶"四大名丛"之一(大红袍、铁罗汉、白鸡冠、水金龟)。因茶树生长在岩石缝隙中,雨后石缝渗水金光闪闪如金龟饮水而得名——"水"指岩石缝中的泉水渗流,"金龟"形容阳光下水面的金色闪耀。外形紧结卷曲重实,色泽乌褐油润。冲泡后梅花香清雅高扬——"岩骨梅花韵"是水金龟在整个武夷岩茶家族中独一无二的香气标识,如雪中蜡梅般清冷而馥郁。

title: Wuyi Shuijinggui Rock Tea (Fujian)
summary: Wuyi Shuijinggui Rock Tea (Fujian) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 武夷铁罗汉
summary: 铁罗汉是武夷岩茶"四大名丛"之一,也是武夷山最早的名丛(宋代已有记载)。以"药香"著称——独特的药草香气深沉有力,汤色深橙红如铁锈色。滋味醇厚刚猛——"铁骨罗汉"之名贴切道出此茶的铮铮风骨。铁罗汉——武夷岩茶中的"硬功夫",四大名丛中最"铁血"的一味。

title: Wuyi Tieluohan Rock Tea (Fujian)
summary: Wuyi Tieluohan Rock Tea (Fujian) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 政和白毫银针
summary: 政和白毫银针与福鼎白毫银针并称白茶中的双峰——政和派以醇厚见长,福鼎派以鲜灵取胜。外形挺直如针,银白似雪,满披白毫,芽头肥硕壮实。冲泡后毫香蜜甜浓郁——政和银针的毫香比福鼎更浓烈深沉,带着大山深处的厚实感。汤色杏黄明亮如浅金色的琥珀,滋味醇厚甘甜,入口即有一股温润而有力的蜜甜席卷整个口腔。

title: Zhenghe Baihao Yinzhen White Tea (Fujian)
summary: Zhenghe Baihao Yinzhen White Tea (Fujian) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 福州茉莉花茶
summary: 福州是中国茉莉花茶的发源地和核心产区。以烘青绿茶为茶坯,与福州伏天茉莉花多次窨制而成。成品茶花交融,花香浓郁鲜灵持久,茶味醇和甘甜。2014年福州茉莉花茶窨制技艺被列入国家级非物质文化遗产。

title: Fuzhou Jasmine Tea
summary: Fuzhou Jasmine Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 黄金桂
summary: 黄金桂是安溪乌龙茶四大当家品种之一，又名"透天香"——香气冲天高扬锐利如穿透云霄。因汤色金黄明亮如黄金、香气有清雅的桂花香而得名。外形紧结卷曲秀丽，色泽黄绿油润。冲泡后桂花香清高冲天扑鼻而来，汤色金黄明亮如液金，滋味清醇甘鲜柔和。黄金桂发芽特早，有"清明茶"之称——当其他乌龙茶还在沉睡时，黄金桂已经迫不及待地绽出最早的春芽。

title: Huangjin Gui (Golden Osmanthus) Oolong
summary: Huangjin Gui (Golden Osmanthus) Oolong is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 建阳白牡丹
summary: 建阳是白牡丹茶的发源地——1922年白牡丹最早在建阳水吉镇创制诞生。建阳白牡丹以建阳本地群体种（小白茶）为原料，与福鼎白牡丹的大白茶品种风格迥异——外形更自然舒展、香气更清雅含蓄、滋味更柔和甘醇，有一种"禅意"的宁静感。建阳也是宋代建窑（建盏）的所在地——中国陶瓷史上最伟大的黑釉瓷器诞生于此。

title: Jianyang White Peony (Fujian)
summary: Jianyang White Peony (Fujian) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 建阳水仙白茶
summary: 建阳是中国水仙茶树的发源地——水仙种原产于建阳小湖乡大湖村祝仙洞,这是中国茶树种质资源史上一个极为重要的地理发现。用传统水仙茶树品种制作白茶是建阳近年来的创新探索——既有白茶的清甜醇和,又带水仙品种特有的清雅兰花韵,两种完全不同的风味体系在同一杯茶中完美融合。外形肥壮重实,白毫显露——水仙大叶种的芽叶肥壮赋予白茶更浓厚的基础。

title: Jianyang Shuixian White Tea (Fujian)
summary: Jianyang Shuixian White Tea (Fujian) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 金骏眉
summary: 金骏眉是 2000 年代在武夷山桐木关一带兴起的单芽红茶，名称属于商品名，不是茶树品种。它以芽头为原料、发酵较轻、通常不做重烟熏，香气偏蜜香和花果香；市场上“全金芽”“顶级”等说法不能替代产地、原料和工艺信息。

title: Jinjunmei
summary: Jinjunmei is a single-bud black tea developed around the 2000s in the Tongmu Pass area of Wuyishan. The name is a commercial name, not a cultivar; it is usually lightly oxidised and not heavily smoked, with honey and floral-fruity notes. “All golden buds” and “top grade” are marketing claims, not origin or process proof.

title: 武夷肉桂
summary: 武夷肉桂是以肉桂茶树品种制成的武夷岩茶，香气常带辛锐的桂皮香和花果香。按现行 GB/T 18745-2006，肉桂是武夷岩茶五类产品之一；正岩、半岩、洲茶属于行业习惯分区，不是 2006 版国标的法定等级。

title: Wuyi Rougui
summary: Wuyi Rougui is a Wuyi rock tea made from the Rougui cultivar, known for a pungent cinnamon-like aroma with floral and fruity notes. Under GB/T 18745-2006, Rougui is one of the five Wuyi rock-tea product categories; Zhengyan and Banyan are trade divisions, not statutory 2006 grades.

title: 坦洋工夫
summary: 坦洋工夫是闽红三大工夫红茶之首,创制于清咸丰元年(1851年),1915年获巴拿马万国博览会金奖。外形紧细匀整、色泽乌润,冲泡后汤色红艳明亮,香气高锐带花果甜香,滋味鲜醇甘甜。曾是中国出口最多、最负盛名的红茶之一。

title: Tanyang Gongfu Black Tea
summary: Tanyang Gongfu Black Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 铁观音
summary: 铁观音原产福建安溪，是茶树品种名，也是乌龙茶商品名。清香、浓香、陈香等风格并存；地理标志产品“安溪铁观音”对产地、品种和工艺有明确要求，不能把品种、商品名和香型混为一谈。

title: Tieguanyin
summary: Tieguanyin is both a tea cultivar and a commercial oolong tea name, originally from Anxi, Fujian. Light-aroma, strong-aroma and aged styles coexist; the protected Anxi Tieguanyin product has specific origin, cultivar and processing requirements.

title: 武夷水仙
summary: 武夷水仙是以水仙茶树品种制成的武夷岩茶，汤感醇厚、常带兰花香；老丛水仙还可能出现木质香和青苔气息。按现行 GB/T 18745-2006，水仙是武夷岩茶五类产品之一，正岩等说法属于行业习惯分区。

title: Wuyi Shuixian
summary: Wuyi Shuixian is a Wuyi rock tea made from the Shuixian cultivar, with a full body and often an orchid aroma; old-bush tea may show woody and mossy notes. Under GB/T 18745-2006 it is one of five Wuyi rock-tea categories; Zhengyan is a trade division, not a 2006 statutory grade.

title: 武夷岩茶
summary: 武夷岩茶是中国十大名茶之一，产于福建省武夷山市武夷山风景区内，是闽北乌龙茶的代表。武夷岩茶以“岩骨花香”著称，茶树生长于武夷山丹霞地貌的岩缝之中，独特的“岩韵”是其品质核心。武夷岩茶品种繁多，以大红袍、水仙、肉桂、名丛四大名枞最为著名。武夷岩茶制作技艺被列入联合国教科文组织人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录，是中国茶文化的瑰宝。

title: Wuyi Rock Tea
summary: Wuyi Rock Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 武夷山半天妖
summary: 半天妖(亦称半天腰、半天鹞)是武夷岩茶"五大名丛"之一(大红袍、白鸡冠、铁罗汉、水金龟、半天妖)。因母树生长在武夷山九龙窠半天腰的悬崖峭壁上——"半天"指半山腰的高度约在武夷山海拔500米处,"妖"形容其香气妖娆迷人多变如妖魅般令人捉摸不定。

title: Wuyi Bantianyao Rock Tea (Fujian)
summary: Wuyi Bantianyao Rock Tea (Fujian) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 政和工夫
summary: 政和工夫是福建三大工夫红茶之一（与坦洋工夫、白琳工夫齐名），产于因宋徽宗年号得名的传奇茶乡——政和县。外形紧细匀整秀丽，色泽乌润油黑。冲泡后蜜甜香浓郁高扬——"蜜韵"是政和工夫最鲜明的味觉标志，汤色红艳明亮如红宝石，滋味浓醇甘甜饱满。

title: Zhenghe Gongfu Black Tea
summary: Zhenghe Gongfu Black Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 政和寿眉
summary: 政和寿眉是白茶中产量最大、最具烟火气息的品类——与银针的精奢和白牡丹的雅致不同，寿眉以亲民的价格和醇厚的滋味成为白茶世界中最温暖的存在。以大白茶一芽三四叶或对夹叶制成——叶片宽大舒展如老人之眉而得名"寿眉"(寿者老也，眉者叶形也)。外形自然舒展，色泽灰绿带褐，看似粗糙实则内含乾坤。

title: Zhenghe Shoumei White Tea (Fujian)
summary: Zhenghe Shoumei White Tea (Fujian) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 正山小种
summary: 正山小种是福建武夷山桐木关一带的小种红茶，传统上用松烟熏焙，形成松烟香和桂圆甜。它是中国最早进入欧洲市场的红茶之一，但“世界所有红茶都源自正山小种”是夸张说法，具体源流仍需史料支持。

title: Zhengshan Xiaozhong
summary: Zhengshan Xiaozhong is a small-leaf black tea from Tongmu Pass, Wuyishan, Fujian, traditionally pine-smoked and known for pine smoke and longan sweetness. It is one of China’s earliest black teas to reach Europe, but “all black tea originated here” is an overstatement.

title: 凤凰单丛
summary: 凤凰单丛是广东潮州凤凰山的半发酵乌龙茶，以单丛品系鲜叶为原料，经晒青、做青、杀青、揉捻、烘焙等工序制成。香气高扬、类型丰富，蜜兰香、黄栀香、玉兰香等命名来自香气联想；茶汤橙黄明亮，滋味浓醇甘爽，山韵明显。

title: Phoenix Dancong
summary: Phoenix Dancong (Fenghuang Dancong) is a half-fermented oolong from the Phoenix Mountains of Chaozhou, Guangdong. It is made from the leaves, dormant buds and young shoots of Dancong lines, through withering, shaking, fixing, rolling and baking. The defining feature is aromatic individuality: honey-orchid, gardenia, magnolia, almond and cinnamon are sensory names for different lines, not botanical varieties.

title: 蜜兰香单丛
summary: 蜜兰香是凤凰单丛中最经典的香型——"蜜"和"兰"的完美结合。浓郁的蜜甜与兰花的清雅——两种截然不同的香型在同一口茶中和谐共处。汤色金黄明亮,滋味甘醇甜滑。"蜜兰香"是凤凰单丛的国民香型——每个初识凤凰单丛的人,都从蜜兰香开始。

title: Milanxiang Dancong Oolong (Guangdong)
summary: Milanxiang Dancong Oolong (Guangdong) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 鸭屎香单丛
summary: 鸭屎香是凤凰单丛中最"名不符实"的品种——名字虽土,品质却惊艳。此茶并非鸭屎味——而是带有独特的杏仁香和奶油甜香。"鸭屎"之名源于一个有趣的传说:茶农为防止他人偷取优异品种,故意将茶名说得难听。结果"鸭屎香"反而以其反差萌成为单丛中最具传播力的网红品种。

title: Yashixiang Dancong (Duck Shit Aroma)
summary: Yashixiang Dancong (Duck Shit Aroma) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 岭头单丛
summary: 岭头单丛是广东乌龙茶的重要分支，产于潮州市饶平县岭头村，与潮安凤凰单丛同源而异流，共同构成了潮州单丛茶的两大流派。岭头单丛以"蜜兰香"为标志性香型——其蜜甜之浓郁在所有乌龙茶中独步天下，好似蜂蜜渍兰花，甜中透雅、雅中蕴甜。成茶外形紧结卷曲、色泽乌褐油润，冲泡后蜜兰香气磅礴而出、满室生香，汤色金黄明亮如流动的琥珀。

title: Lingtou Dancong Oolong
summary: Lingtou Dancong Oolong is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 英德红茶
summary: 英德红茶是中国红茶"浓强鲜"风格的代表之作，产于广东省清远市英德市——北江中游的喀斯特峰林之间。英德红茶以"浓、强、鲜"三字诀闻名于世：浓者汤色红艳浓厚如红宝石、滋味饱满有力；强者茶汤入口有"力道"，茶气充沛、穿透力强；鲜者香气鲜活灵动、不带沉闷的发酵味。

title: Yingde Black Tea
summary: Yingde Black Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 桂林桂花茶
summary: 桂林桂花茶以"桂"字双关——广西(桂)的桂花(桂),两者都在桂林这一山水甲天下之地完美交汇。以本地绿茶或红茶为基茶,与桂林金桂窨制而成。冲泡后桂花甜香四溢,茶汤金黄明亮,滋味甘甜醇和。桂林山水间的桂花茶——品茗如游漓江画中。
location: 中国 · 广西壮族自治区

title: Guilin Osmanthus Tea (Guangxi)
summary: Guilin Osmanthus Tea (Guangxi) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 六堡茶
summary: 六堡茶是广西梧州苍梧县一带的黑茶，以渥堆、蒸压和陈化为特点，汤色红浓，常被描述为带槟榔香、木香或陈香。它属于黑茶，不是普洱茶；具体等级、产地和陈化信息应看执行标准与包装。
location: 中国 · 广西壮族自治区

title: Liubao tea
summary: Liubao tea is a dark tea from Cangwu, Wuzhou, Guangxi, known for pile fermentation, steaming/pressing and ageing. Its liquor is deep red, with betel-nut, woody or aged notes. It is a dark tea, not Pu-erh; check grade, origin and storage on the label.

title: 都匀毛尖
summary: 都匀毛尖是贵州黔南的卷曲形绿茶，也是跨都匀、福泉、瓮安等县市的地理标志保护产品。它常被称作“鱼钩茶”，以细紧卷曲、满披白毫、嫩香栗香和鲜醇回甘为特征；2024 年都匀市茶园 37.83 万亩、产茶 1.26 万吨、产值 33.05 亿元，品牌价值 52.23 亿元。

title: Duyun Maojian Tea
summary: Duyun Maojian is a curled green tea from Qiannan, Guizhou, and a geographical-indication protected product spanning Duyun, Fuquan, Weng'an and other counties. Often called “Yugou tea” (fish-hook tea), it has tight curly leaf, abundant white hairs, a tender and chestnut aroma and a fresh, sweet finish. In 2024 Duyun City reported 378,300 mu of tea gardens, 12,600 tonnes of tea and RMB 3.305 billion in output value, with a brand value of RMB 5.223 billion.

title: 贵定云雾贡茶（Guiding Yunwu Tribute Tea）
summary: 贵定云雾贡茶是贵州贵定县的国家农产品地理标志区域绿茶，核心产区在云雾镇，不是单一企业品牌。2010 年 9 月获农业部国家地理标志产品认证，2013 年 7 月获地理标志证明商标；2024 年全县茶园 25.56 万亩、投产 24.73 万亩、产量 1.1807 万吨、同比约 +5.35%，新华网同期口径为一产年产值约 5.8 亿元。地方志与县方口径称贵定有 2000 多年种茶史、1000 多年贡茶史、500 多年佛茶史；乾隆五十五年（1790）拨银 420 两，立“万古流芳”贡茶碑。品种以贵定鸟王种为主，2014 年 6 月通过省级良种审定；DB52/T 547—2017 把产品分为珍贡、特级、一级、二级。

title: Guiding Yunwu Tribute Tea
titleAlt: 贵定云雾贡茶（Guiding Yunwu Tribute Tea）
summary: Guiding Yunwu Tribute Tea is a nationally protected regional green tea from Guiding County in Guizhou, China. Its core production area is Yunwu Town, and it is a geographical indication, not a single company brand. It received national agricultural GI recognition in September 2010 and a geographical indication certification mark in July 2013. At the end of 2024 the county had 255,600 mu (about 17,040 ha) of tea gardens, 247,300 mu (about 16,487 ha) in production, and an output of 11,807 tonnes, up about 5.35% year on year; Xinhua's contemporaneous figure for primary-sector output value was about RMB 580 million. Local records describe 2,000-plus years of tea growing, 1,000-plus years of tribute tea and 500-plus years of Buddhist tea history; in 1790 the Qianlong court allocated 420 taels of silver and a “Wangu Liufang” tribute stele was erected. The main cultivar is Guiding Niaowang, approved as a provincial improved variety in June 2014, and DB52/T 547—2017 grades the product as Zhengong, Special Grade, Grade 1 and Grade 2.

title: 贵州黄金芽
summary: 贵州黄金芽是一种稀有的黄色变异茶树种——茶芽全年呈金黄色,氨基酸含量极高(可达9%),滋味极鲜甜。以"闷黄"工艺制作成黄茶,外形金黄润亮,香气清甜如蜜,汤色杏黄金亮,滋味甘醇如"液体黄金"。是中国黄茶中最小众也最惊艳的品种。

title: Guizhou Golden Bud Yellow Tea
summary: Guizhou Golden Bud Yellow Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 石阡苔茶
summary: 石阡苔茶是贵州石阡县的地理标志绿茶，也是当地茶树群体与产品的统称。2009 年获国家地理标志产品保护，2010 年注册地理标志证明商标，2013 年获中国驰名商标；地方材料称其为贵州三大名茶之一。2025 年全县干茶 2.951 万吨、综合产值 32 亿元、茶园 43.6 万亩，古茶树 5 万余株。

title: Shiqian Taicha
summary: Shiqian Taicha is a geographical-indication green tea from Shiqian County, Guizhou, and the name covers both the local tea population and the product. It received national GI product protection in 2009, was registered as a GI certification mark in 2010 and as a China Well-Known Trademark in 2013; local material calls it one of Guizhou’s three famous teas. In 2025 the county reported 29,510 tonnes of finished tea, RMB 3.2 billion in combined output value, 436,000 mu of tea gardens and more than 50,000 ancient tea plants.

title: 信阳毛尖
summary: 信阳毛尖是中国十大名茶之一，产于河南信阳大别山区。其外形细直圆光，白毫满披，色泽翠绿。冲泡后汤色嫩绿明亮，香气清高持久，有熟板栗香，滋味浓醇回甘。信阳毛尖以"细、圆、光、直、多白毫、香高、味浓、汤色绿"的独特风格而著称。

title: Xinyang Maojian
summary: A spring green tea from the Dabie Mountains around Xinyang, Henan, known for fine straight needles, white down, chestnut aroma and a brisk, full-bodied finish.

title: 恩施玉露
summary: 恩施玉露是中国传统蒸青绿茶的代表，产于湖北恩施。其外形条索紧圆光滑，色泽苍翠绿润，状如松针。冲泡后汤色嫩绿明亮，香气清高持久，滋味鲜爽甘醇。恩施玉露是中国现存唯一的蒸青绿茶，其蒸青工艺源自唐代，在日本保留并发扬光大，是中国这一古老工艺的活化石。

title: Enshi Yulu Tea
summary: Enshi Yulu Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 来凤藤茶
titleAlt: Laifeng Teng Cha (Ampelopsis Herbal Tea, Hubei)
summary: 来凤藤茶是土家族的传统药茶——以显齿蛇葡萄(Ampelopsis grossedentata)的嫩叶制成。不是茶科植物但已有千年饮用历史。外形卷曲,色泽墨绿。冲泡后汤色浅绿,入口微苦随即回甘猛烈——喉咙有持久的甘甜和清凉感。藤茶富含二氢杨梅素——一种天然的黄酮类活性成分。

title: Laifeng Teng Cha (Ampelopsis Herbal Tea, Hubei)
summary: Laifeng Teng Cha (Ampelopsis Herbal Tea, Hubei) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 湖北青砖茶
summary: 青砖茶是中国最古老的紧压黑茶之一,产于湖北赤壁(羊楼洞)。外形为长方形青砖(每块重约2公斤),色泽青褐。冲泡后汤色红浓明亮,陈香醇厚持久。历史上青砖茶大量销往蒙古和俄罗斯——赤壁羊楼洞是中俄万里茶道的重要起点,被誉为"世界茶业第一古镇"。

title: Hubei Qingzhuan (Green Brick Tea)
summary: Hubei Qingzhuan (Green Brick Tea) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 宜红工夫
summary: 宜红工夫，鄂西武陵山区之红茶瑰宝，与祁红、滇红鼎足而三，享誉遐迩。其条索紧细如弦，锋苗秀挺，色泽乌润如墨玉含光，静置则幽幽甜香自叶间渗出，如果蜜将凝而未凝。沸泉瀹之，高甜之香如春山晨雾般氤氲升起，果蜜之韵萦绕满室。汤色红艳澄澈，若琥珀流光，金圈明灿。入口浓醇鲜爽，甜润饱满，舌底鸣泉，喉间生津，回甘如清溪绵延不绝。

title: Yihong Gongfu Black Tea
summary: Yihong Gongfu Black Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 远安黄茶
summary: 远安黄茶，产于宜昌远安县——中华人文始祖嫘祖之故里，亦为湖北三大黄茶之一。远安乃黄帝元妃嫘祖的诞生地，嫘祖始教民养蚕缫丝，华夏文明的丝帛之光从此处亮起。远安黄茶得黄茶独有之「闷黄」工艺——炒青之后趁热堆积，以湿热作用使茶叶轻微发酵，叶色由绿转黄，苦涩退去，甜醇渐生。其茶外形紧细卷曲，色泽黄润如熟谷。

title: Yuan'an Yellow Tea
summary: Yuan'an Yellow Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 安化黑茶
summary: 安化黑茶是湖南安化一带的黑茶总称，包括天尖、贡尖、生尖、茯砖、黑砖、花砖和花卷等。它们共享渥堆后发酵的基本路径，但原料、压制方式、发花和干燥工艺不同；具体产品应看执行标准与标签。

title: Anhua dark tea
summary: Anhua dark tea is a family of dark teas from Anhua, Hunan, including Tianjian, Gongjian, Shengjian, Fu brick, Hei brick, Hua brick and Hua Juan. They share pile fermentation but differ in material, pressing, fungal growth and drying; check the product standard and label.

title: 安化天尖
summary: 安化天尖是安化黑茶中等级最高的品类——以一级嫩茶叶为原料,经复杂的后发酵工艺制成。历史上天尖是晋商(山西茶商)定制的高端边销茶,沿茶马古道远销蒙古和俄罗斯。外形紧细匀整,色泽黑褐油润。冲泡后松烟香和药香交融,汤色橙红明亮,滋味醇厚回甘。

title: Anhua Tianjian Dark Tea
summary: Anhua Tianjian Dark Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 张家界莓茶
summary: 张家界莓茶以显齿蛇葡萄(与湖北来凤藤茶同种植物)为原料的武陵山区代茶饮品。冲泡后汤色浅绿透亮,入口微苦但回甘强烈——喉咙有持久的"莓果般的甘甜"。这就是"莓茶"名称的由来。莓茶是张家界旅游伴手礼中的"健康明星"——每天带走的不是茶,是武陵山的元气。

title: Zhangjiajie Mei Tea (Hunan Herbal)
summary: Zhangjiajie Mei Tea (Hunan Herbal) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 君山银针
summary: 君山银针是湖南岳阳君山岛所产的黄芽茶，以肥壮单芽和闷黄工艺为特点。干茶芽身金黄、白毫显露，常被形容为“金镶玉”；冲泡时的芽头升降是观赏特征，但不能替代对原料、工艺和仓储的判断。

title: Junshan Yinzhen
summary: Junshan Yinzhen is a yellow bud tea from Junshan Island in Yueyang, Hunan, made from plump single buds and yellowed through menhuang. The golden bud body with white down is traditionally called “gold inlaid with jade”; the brewing display is a visual feature, not a quality guarantee.

title: 碧螺春
summary: 碧螺春是江苏苏州太湖洞庭山的炒青绿茶，以细嫩芽叶手工炒制，条索纤细卷曲如螺、白毫显露，香气清鲜、滋味鲜醇。洞庭山茶果间作的栽培传统与“吓煞人香”的民间叫法，是它最容易被记住的两个标签。

title: Biluochun
summary: Biluochun is a pan-fired spring green tea from the Dongting hills in Lake Tai, Jiangsu. The leaf is tiny, tightly curled and covered with white down; the tea is famous for a fresh, sweet, slightly fruity cup and for the tea–fruit intercropping tradition of Dongting Mountain.

title: 宜兴红茶
summary: 宜兴不仅是紫砂壶的故乡,也是红茶的新秀。以宜兴阳羡茶区的群体种为原料制作的工夫红茶,外形紧细微曲,金毫显露。冲泡后蜜甜香中带着宜兴特有的紫砂矿物的微妙气息。宜兴红茶配宜兴紫砂壶——"宜红宜兴,壶茶一味"。宜兴红茶让紫砂壶之都有了足以匹配的红茶。

title: Yixing Black Tea (Jiangsu)
summary: Yixing Black Tea (Jiangsu) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 南京雨花茶
summary: 南京雨花茶是1959年为纪念雨花台革命烈士而创制的名茶。外形紧直浑圆似松针,色泽翠绿。冲泡后香气清雅高爽,滋味鲜醇回甘。雨花茶形似松针象征烈士精神万古长青,是"红色文化"与茶文化的完美结合。1959年与安化松针并称"中国针形绿茶双璧"。

title: Nanjing Yuhua Green Tea
summary: Nanjing Yuhua Green Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 苏州茉莉花茶
summary: 苏州茉莉花茶是中国茉莉花茶中最雅致的一支。以碧螺春产区附近的烘青绿茶为茶坯,与苏州太湖茉莉花窨制。苏州的温婉与细腻渗透进每一片花茶——花香不浓不淡刚刚好,茶味清甜不涩,是"江南花茶"的完美诠释。苏州园林中品一盏茉莉花茶,天人合一。

title: Suzhou Jasmine Tea (Jiangsu)
summary: Suzhou Jasmine Tea (Jiangsu) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 庐山云雾茶
summary: 庐山云雾茶是中国传统名茶之一，产于江西庐山。庐山云雾缭绕，四季不绝，茶叶在云雾的滋润下生长，形成了独特的品质。其外形条索秀丽，青翠多毫。冲泡后汤色清澈明亮，香气鲜爽持久，滋味醇厚甘甜。庐山云雾茶以"香馨、味醇、色翠、汤清"著称。

title: Lushan Yunwu Tea
summary: Lushan Yunwu Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 宁红工夫
summary: 宁红工夫是中国最早的工夫红茶之一，产于江西省修水县（古称宁州），与安徽祁红并称“祁红宁红”，是中国工夫红茶的双璧。宁红工夫外形紧结秀丽，色泽乌润，金毫显露，香气高锐持久，滋味醇厚甘甜，汤色红艳明亮。宁红工夫在清末民初大量出口欧洲，被誉为“茶盖中华，价甲天下”，是中国红茶出口史上的重要篇章。

title: Ninghong Gongfu Black Tea
summary: Ninghong Gongfu Black Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 汉中仙毫（汉中地理标志绿茶）
summary: 汉中仙毫是陕西汉中的地理标志区域公用品牌，不是单一企业、单一茶树品种或单一零售产品。2007 年国家质检总局第 178 号公告批准对汉中仙毫实施地理标志产品保护，保护范围覆盖汉中 8 个产茶县、112 个产茶乡镇、894 个产茶村。官方公告把鲜叶采摘分为特级、一级、二级，并规定摊青、杀青、理条、做型、提毫、烘干、精选七步工艺。2024 年汉中全市茶园 132.4 万亩、茶叶总产量 7.1 万吨、干毛茶产值 110.7 亿元；汉中仙毫产量 1,675 吨、产值 19.8 亿元。2025 年品牌价值 50.98 亿元，汉中仙毫国家地理标志保护示范区通过实地验收。

title: Hanzhong Xianhao
titleAlt: 汉中仙毫（汉中地理标志绿茶）
summary: Hanzhong Xianhao is a geographical indication regional public brand for green tea in Hanzhong, Shaanxi, China. It is not a single company, a single cultivar, or a single retail SKU. In 2007, AQSIQ Announcement No. 178 placed Hanzhong Xianhao under geographical indication product protection across eight tea-producing counties, 112 townships and 894 villages. The official notice defines three fresh-leaf grades — Special, First and Second — and a seven-step process: spreading, killing the green, carding, shaping, raising the white hairs, drying and sorting. In 2024, Hanzhong had 132.4 wan mu (about 88,270 ha) of tea gardens, 71,000 tonnes of total tea output and CNY 11.07 billion in dry maocha value; Hanzhong Xianhao itself produced 1,675 tonnes worth CNY 1.98 billion. The 2025 brand value was CNY 5.098 billion, and the national geographical indication protection demonstration zone passed an on-site review in September 2025.

title: 平利绞股蓝
summary: 平利绞股蓝是陕西平利县的地理标志产品，原料为葫芦科草质藤本植物绞股蓝的地上部分，不是山茶科茶树，也不是药品。2004 年国家质检总局第 189 号公告把保护范围划为平利县现辖行政区域，并规定海拔 400—1600 米、pH 6.0—7.5、有机质 2.0% 以上等产地条件。2019 年陕西省食品安全地方标准把产品分为龙须、叶片、茎叶，推荐每日食用量不超过 6 克，并列出孕妇、哺乳期妇女和 14 周岁以下儿童为不适宜人群。2024 年平利绞股蓝种植 5 万亩、干茶 6,500 吨、产值 7 亿元；2025 年品牌价值评估为 9.34 亿元。

title: Pingli Jiaogulan
summary: Pingli Jiaogulan is a geographical indication product from Pingli County in Ankang, Shaanxi. Its raw material is the aerial part of Gynostemma pentaphyllum, a perennial cucurbitaceous vine — not a tea plant (Camellia sinensis) and not a medicine. AQSIQ Announcement No. 189 of 2004 protects the whole county and sets site conditions of 400–1,600 m altitude, pH 6.0–7.5 and organic matter above 2.0%. The 2019 Shaanxi food safety standard divides the product into longxu tips, leaves and stems, recommends no more than 6 g a day, and lists pregnant or nursing women and children under 14 as unsuitable. In 2024 Pingli had 5 wan mu (about 3,330 ha) of jiaogulan, 6,500 tonnes of dried tea and CNY 700 million in output value; the 2025 brand value was CNY 934 million.

title: 陕西茯砖茶
summary: 陕西茯砖茶是陕西咸阳一带的后发酵黑茶，核心加工传统在泾阳。它用陕南、湖南、四川等地的黑毛茶作原料，经渥堆、蒸压和发花制成砖形；砖内金黄色“金花”是冠突散囊菌，不是另加的配料。2013 年“泾阳茯砖茶”获批地理标志保护，2021 年咸阳茯茶制作技艺列入第五批国家级非遗。它不是红茶，也不能凭“金花”推断保健功效。

title: Shaanxi Fu Brick Tea
summary: Shaanxi Fu brick tea is a post-fermented dark tea centred on Jingyang in Xianyang, Shaanxi. It is made from black maocha from southern Shaanxi, Hunan and Sichuan, then pile-fermented, steamed, pressed and incubated so that golden “flowers” of Eurotium cristatum grow inside the brick. Jingyang Fu brick tea received geographical indication protection in 2013; Xianyang Fu tea making was added to the national intangible heritage list in 2021. It is not a black tea, and golden flowers are not evidence of a health effect.

title: 西乡午子仙毫
summary: 午子仙毫是陕西西乡县在 1985 年定型、由茶学家陈椽命名的半烘炒条形绿茶。它常被西乡县方称作“汉中仙毫的前身”之一，但今天不是独立的地理标志品牌：2005 年汉中启动茶叶品牌整合，2007 年“汉中仙毫”成为地理标志保护产品，午子仙毫这个名字更多作为历史名茶称谓和企业产品名出现。西乡 2024 年茶业部门口径为茶园 36 万亩、干毛茶 2.01 万吨、产值 29.46 亿元；县统计公报同期为 34.35 万亩、1.678 万吨，两套数字不能混用。

title: Xixiang Wuzi Xianhao
summary: Wuzi Xianhao is a strip-shaped green tea from Xixiang County, Shaanxi, standardised in 1985 and named by tea scholar Chen Chuan. Xixiang officials often call it a predecessor of Hanzhong Xianhao, but it is not a separate geographical indication today: Hanzhong began consolidating local tea brands in 2005, and the geographical indication approved in 2007 is “Hanzhong Xianhao”. In 2024 the county's tea-industry figures were 360,000 mu of tea gardens, 20,100 tonnes of dry maocha and CNY 2.946 billion in output value; the county statistical communiqué gives 343,500 mu and 16,780 tonnes. The two sets of figures use different reporting systems and should not be mixed.

title: 紫阳毛尖
summary: 紫阳毛尖是陕西紫阳的传统历史名茶，也是经国家知识产权局核准注册的地理标志证明商标。今天它多以“紫阳富硒茶”区域公用品牌下的绿茶产品出现；2004 年原产地域保护、2023 年保护升级针对的是“紫阳富硒茶”，不是“紫阳毛尖”四个字。2024 年全县茶园 26 万亩、茶产量 1.28 万吨、产值 35.5 亿元、综合产值 70 亿元；这些是产业口径，不是统计公报。

title: Ziyang Maojian
summary: Ziyang Maojian is a traditional famous tea from Ziyang County, Shaanxi, and a registered geographical-indication certification trademark. Today it usually appears as a green-tea product under the regional public brand “Ziyang Selenium-Rich Tea”; the 2004 protected product and the 2023 protection upgrade cover “Ziyang Selenium-Rich Tea”, not the four characters “Ziyang Maojian”. In 2024 the county reported 260,000 mu of tea gardens, 12,800 tonnes of tea, CNY 3.55 billion in output value and CNY 7 billion in composite output. These are industry figures, not statistical-communiqué figures.

title: 崂山绿茶
summary: 崂山绿茶是中国最北端的绿茶产区之一,产于道教名山——青岛崂山。北纬36度的地理位置使崂山茶生长期长、内含物质积累丰富。外形紧结壮实,色泽翠绿。冲泡后豆香浓郁,滋味醇厚,带有独特的"海风韵味"——茶树被海雾滋养,茶汤中有一丝不易察觉的海潮鲜味。

title: Laoshan Green Tea
summary: Laoshan Green Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 日照绿茶
summary: 日照绿茶与崂山绿茶并称"江北双璧",是中国北方绿茶的另一代表。日照位于北纬35度,濒临黄海。外形紧结卷曲,色泽墨绿。冲泡后栗香浓郁高扬,滋味浓厚回甘。"北方茶,南方味"——日照绿茶以浓郁见长,风格接近安徽炒青。

title: Rizhao Green Tea
summary: Rizhao Green Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 峨眉竹叶青
summary: 峨眉竹叶青产于佛教四大名山之一的峨眉山，因外形扁平挺直、两头尖细、形似嫩竹叶而得名。其色泽翠绿光润如春山新雨，冲泡后嫩栗香与清雅豆香交织升腾，汤色嫩绿清澈如翡翠凝露。入口鲜爽甘醇，喉韵清甜绵长，饮罢舌底鸣泉、齿颊留芳。竹叶青采峨眉山清明前独芽或一芽一叶初展精制而成，被誉为"峨眉之宝"，是中国高端绿茶中形、色、香、味俱臻上乘的代表之作。

title: Emei Zhuyeqing Green Tea
summary: Emei Zhuyeqing Green Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 四川康砖茶
summary: 康砖茶是四川南路边茶的代表,历史上专供西藏和青海藏区。外形为砖块状,色泽棕褐。冲泡后陈香浓郁,汤色深红,滋味醇和。雅安是茶马古道川藏线的起点——康砖茶从这里翻越二郎山、折多山进入藏区,维系汉藏民族的千年茶缘。

title: Sichuan Kangzhuan Brick Tea
summary: Sichuan Kangzhuan Brick Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 蒙顶甘露
summary: 蒙顶甘露是中国最古老的名茶——西汉甘露年间(公元前53年),茶祖吴理真在蒙顶山上清峰手植七株茶树,开创了世界人工种茶的先河。蒙顶甘露外形紧秀卷曲,白毫显露,色泽翠绿。冲泡后嫩香馥郁——"蒙顶甘露,人间第一茶"。滋味鲜爽回甘,被誉为"甘露"——如晨露般清甜。

title: Mengding Ganlu (Sichuan Famous Green Tea)
summary: Mengding Ganlu (Sichuan Famous Green Tea) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 名山蒙顶黄芽
summary: 蒙顶黄芽是四川雅安蒙顶山所产的黄芽茶，以单芽和“闷黄”工艺为特点。干茶金黄润亮，汤色杏黄，香气以甜香、嫩香为主；它与蒙顶甘露同属蒙顶茶传统，但茶类和工艺不同。

title: Mengding Huangya
summary: Mengding Huangya is a yellow bud tea from Mengding Mountain in Ya’an, Sichuan, made from single buds and yellowed through menhuang. It has a golden, glossy appearance and an apricot-yellow liquor with sweet, tender aromas; it shares the Mengding tradition with Mengding Ganlu but is a different tea family.

title: 邛崃黑茶
summary: 邛崃黑茶是四川"西路边茶"的代表——与雅安"南路边茶"相对。历史上销往阿坝、甘南和青海藏区。外形粗松,色泽褐黑。冲泡后陈香浓郁——松烟香和木质药香,汤色深红,滋味醇和。邛崃是南方丝绸之路的重要驿站——黑茶从这里翻越雪山进入川西北藏区。

title: Qionglai Dark Tea (Sichuan)
summary: Qionglai Dark Tea (Sichuan) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 雅安藏茶
summary: 雅安藏茶是中国黑茶的鼻祖,自唐宋以来沿茶马古道运销藏区,藏民"宁可三日无粮,不可一日无茶"。以粗老茶叶经复杂后发酵制成,茶汤红浓明亮,滋味醇厚平和,是藏民酥油茶的原料。

title: Yaan Tibetan Tea (Dark Tea)
summary: Yaan Tibetan Tea (Dark Tea) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 冻顶乌龙茶
summary: 冻顶乌龙茶是台湾最知名的乌龙茶，产于南投县鹿谷乡冻顶山。其外形卷曲呈半球形，色泽墨绿油润。冲泡后汤色金黄明亮，带有琥珀光晕，香气清雅持久，带花香和果香，滋味醇厚甘润，回甘强。

title: Dongding Oolong Tea
summary: Dongding Oolong Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 东方美人(膨风茶)
summary: 东方美人是台湾最传奇的乌龙茶,又称"膨风茶"(客家话"吹牛"之意)。其独特之处在于茶叶必须被小绿叶蝉叮咬,虫咬刺激茶树产生防御物质,使制成的茶带有独特的蜜香和果香。茶汤如琥珀般橙红明亮,蜜甜香浓郁,滋味圆润甘醇。英国女王伊丽莎白二世品尝后赞为"东方美人"。

title: Oriental Beauty (Pengfeng Oolong)
summary: Oriental Beauty (Pengfeng Oolong) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 文山包种茶
summary: 文山包种茶是台湾乌龙茶中发酵程度最轻的品种,介于绿茶和乌龙茶之间。外形紧结呈条索状,色泽墨绿。冲泡后清香如兰,汤色蜜绿清澈,滋味鲜爽甘醇。是台湾"北包种、南乌龙"两大乌龙茶流派之一。包种茶的"清香"与高山乌龙茶的"浓香"形成鲜明对比。

title: Wenshan Baozhong Oolong
summary: Wenshan Baozhong Oolong is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 邦东昔归
summary: 昔归产于临沧邦东乡忙麓山,是普洱茶界的又一天价传奇。昔归古树茶以"柔中带刚"著称——汤柔水滑如丝绸,但茶气霸道入骨。独特的"菌香"和"岩韵"使其在普洱茶中独树一帜。昔归古茶园临澜沧江,江风江雾终年滋润茶树。

title: Bangdong Xigui Pu-erh
summary: Bangdong Xigui Pu-erh is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 冰岛老寨古树
summary: 冰岛(当地读"丙岛")是普洱茶中的"王者",以极致的冰糖甜闻名。冰岛老寨古树生普入口即甜,冰糖韵贯穿始终,回甘如泉涌,生津如浪涌。冰岛古树年产仅几百公斤,是普洱茶价格的塔尖,一公斤老寨古树动辄数万元甚至十数万元。

title: Bingdao Old Village Raw Pu-erh
summary: Bingdao Old Village Raw Pu-erh is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 凤庆滇红
summary: 凤庆滇红是云南凤庆一带以大叶种制作的工夫红茶，常简称“滇红”。它条索肥壮、金毫较显，香气高长，滋味浓强；具体产品等级和产地范围应看执行标准与包装，不能把“滇红”与普洱茶混为一谈。

title: Fengqing Dianhong
summary: Fengqing Dianhong is a congou black tea from Fengqing, Yunnan, made from large-leaf cultivars. It has plump, downy leaves, a high aroma and a strong, full taste. Check origin, grade and standard on the label; Dianhong is not Pu-erh.

title: 景迈山生普
summary: 景迈山是2023年新晋世界文化遗产"普洱景迈山古茶林文化景观"所在地,拥有世界上规模最大、保存最完好的古茶林。景迈生普以千年古茶树为原料,香气独特——兰花蜜香馥郁,茶汤金黄透亮,滋味醇厚甜润,山野气韵强烈,回甘生津迅猛持久。

title: Jingmai Mountain Raw Pu-erh
summary: Jingmai Mountain Raw Pu-erh is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 勐海熟普
summary: 勐海是普洱熟茶的发源地和最核心产区。1973年人工渥堆发酵技术在勐海茶厂试验成功,开创了熟普时代。勐海熟普以"勐海味"著称——汤色酒红透亮,陈香纯正,滋味醇厚甘滑,有一种不可复制的海味(即"勐海味")。

title: Menghai Ripe Pu-erh Tea
summary: Menghai Ripe Pu-erh Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 普洱茶
summary: 普洱茶是以云南大叶种晒青毛茶为原料，经后发酵加工而成的黑茶，是中国历史名茶之一。普洱茶以“越陈越香”的独特品质著称，分为生茶和熟茶两大类型。生茶经自然陈化、熟茶经人工渥堆发酵，茶性温和，滋味醇厚回甘，风味以醇厚回甘为主，具体表现随批次与冲泡而异。

title: Pu'er Tea
summary: Pu'er Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 普洱生茶
summary: 普洱生茶是地理标志产品普洱茶的两大类型之一：以云南大叶种晒青茶为原料，经蒸压成型、干燥制成，不经过人工渥堆。新茶清香、苦涩较明显，存放后汤色转深、滋味转醇，但“越陈越香”是仓储与市场的经验判断，不是标准保证。

title: Raw Pu-erh
summary: Raw Pu-erh (sheng pu'er) is one of the two product types of geographical-indication Pu-erh: Yunnan large-leaf sun-dried tea, steamed, pressed and dried, without pile fermentation. It starts bright, floral and bitter, then changes with storage — but ageing is a storage outcome, not a standard guarantee.

title: 普洱熟茶
summary: 普洱熟茶是普洱茶的两大类型之一：以云南大叶种晒青茶为原料，经人工渥堆后发酵、干燥、筛分、蒸压或不压制成。汤色红浓、滋味醇厚顺滑，新茶可能带堆味，需退堆后饮用。

title: Ripe Pu-erh
summary: Ripe Pu-erh (shou pu'er) is the pile-fermented branch of geographical-indication Pu-erh. Yunnan large-leaf sun-dried tea is stacked, moistened, turned and fermented, then dried, sorted and pressed or left loose. The cup is deep red, thick and smooth, with aged, woody and dried-fruit notes; new tea often needs time to lose its pile scent.

title: 易武古树茶
summary: 易武是普洱茶"古六大茶山"之一,历史上是普洱茶最核心的产地和集散地。易武古树生普以"柔"著称——汤柔水甜,香扬水柔,是普洱茶中最温柔优雅的存在。新茶清甜如蜜,陈化后出梅子香和樟香,十年以上的老易武堪称"液体黄金"。

title: Yiwu Ancient Tree Pu-erh
summary: Yiwu Ancient Tree Pu-erh is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 月光白
summary: 月光白是云南特有的白茶品种，因制作工艺独特——鲜叶在月光下自然萎凋，不见阳光而得名。月光白以云南大叶种为原料，芽头肥壮，白毫密布，叶面黑亮、叶背白毫，黑白相间如月夜光影。月光白兼具白茶的清雅和普洱的醇厚，香气馥郁带蜜香和果香，汤色杏黄明亮，滋味甘甜醇和，是云南白茶的代表之作。

title: Moonlight White Tea
summary: Moonlight White Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 下关沱茶(甲级)
summary: 下关沱茶是中国沱茶(碗状紧压茶)的代表。大理下关茶厂自1902年开始生产沱茶,百年历史、技艺传承。外形为碗臼状紧压茶,色泽墨绿。冲泡后烟香浓郁(下关沱的标志性风味),滋味浓厚回甘。下关是茶马古道上大理的重要关隘——沱茶从这里走向藏区和四川。

title: Xiaguan Tuocha (Grade A Pu-erh)
summary: Xiaguan Tuocha (Grade A Pu-erh) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 西双版纳老班章
summary: 老班章是普洱茶界的"王者"——布朗山深处的哈尼族村寨,古茶园海拔1700-1900米。老班章生普以"霸气"著称——入口极苦但化得极快,继而猛烈回甘,茶气霸道,体感强烈。是普洱茶中价格最高的山头茶之一,被称为"普洱之王"。喝老班章不仅仅是喝茶——是体验普洱茶力量最直接的冲击。老班章古树茶年产量稀少,极端抢手。

title: Xishuangbanna Laobanzhang Raw Pu-erh
summary: Xishuangbanna Laobanzhang Raw Pu-erh is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 安吉白茶
summary: 安吉白茶名字里有“白茶”，工艺上却是绿茶。它用“白叶一号”品种的白化期鲜叶为原料，按绿茶工艺制成，产品分凤形、龙形等。春季新芽玉白、叶脉浅绿，成品色泽翠绿间金黄，汤色鹅黄清亮，滋味鲜爽甘醇。现行标准为 GB/T 20354-2006，2026 版将于 2027-04-01 实施。

title: Anji Baicha
summary: Anji Baicha is a green tea from Anji, Zhejiang, despite its name. It is made from the Baiye Yihao cultivar during its spring pale-leaf stage, then fixed, shaped and dried as a green tea. The leaf is jade-white with green veins, the liquor pale yellow, and the taste unusually fresh, sweet and low in bitterness. The 2006 standard is still in force; a 2026 revision takes effect on 2027-04-01.

title: 顾渚紫笋
summary: 顾渚紫笋产于长兴顾渚山,是中国最古老的贡茶之一。茶圣陆羽在《茶经》中盛赞其为天下名茶之冠。嫩芽紫红色、形似竹笋,故得"紫笋"之名。蒸青工艺保留唐代遗风,茶汤清香鲜爽如品一段千年茶史。

title: Guzhu Purple Bamboo Shoot Tea
summary: Guzhu Purple Bamboo Shoot Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 金奖惠明茶
summary: 金奖惠明茶产于景宁畲族自治县惠明寺村,因1915年巴拿马万国博览会获金奖而名扬天下。外形细紧卷曲、色泽翠绿,香气清高带花果香,滋味鲜爽醇厚,是浙江省唯一获巴拿马金奖的历史名茶。

title: Jingning Huiming Tea
summary: Jingning Huiming Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 金华茉莉花茶
summary: 金华茉莉花茶是江南茉莉花茶的代表。与福州茉莉花茶齐名,"北有福州,南有金华"。金华的烘青绿茶做茶坯,与本地伏天茉莉花反复窨制,花香鲜灵持久,茶味清醇甘甜。金华是诗人李清照晚年寓居之地——"只恐双溪舴艋舟,载不动许多愁。"一盏金华茉莉花茶,清香解忧。

title: Jinhua Jasmine Tea (Zhejiang)
summary: Jinhua Jasmine Tea (Zhejiang) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 龙井红茶(九曲红梅)
summary: 九曲红梅又称"龙井红茶",是浙江唯一的传统工夫红茶——与龙井绿茶共享同一产区(西湖周边)。外形紧细弯曲似九曲溪流,色泽乌润,金毫显露。冲泡后蜜甜香和花香交融,汤色红艳明亮,滋味甘醇。龙井绿茶的故乡也有红茶的精彩——九曲红梅是杭州茶叶的另一张面孔。

title: Longjing Black Tea (Jiuqu Hongmei)
summary: Longjing Black Tea (Jiuqu Hongmei) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 龙井茶
summary: 龙井茶是杭州一带的炒青绿茶，以扁平挺秀、清香鲜爽著称。地理标志标准规定了保护范围、适宜品种和工艺要求；西湖产区传统上有狮、龙、云、虎、梅等字号，但产区、等级和品种不能混为一谈。

title: Longjing tea
summary: Longjing is a pan-fired green tea from the Hangzhou area, known for its flat, straight leaves and fresh, fragrant taste. The geographical indication standard defines its protected area, suitable cultivars and processing requirements; West Lake’s traditional labels are not the same as statutory grades.

title: 莫干黄芽
summary: 莫干黄芽产于德清莫干山,是浙江稀有黄茶珍品。外形紧细匀整,色泽金黄润亮。采用"闷黄"工艺,香气清甜如蜜,滋味醇和甘爽。莫干山以避暑胜地和干将莫邪铸剑传说闻名,茶与山同名,相得益彰。

title: Mogan Yellow Bud Tea
summary: Mogan Yellow Bud Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 平阳黄汤茶
summary: 平阳黄汤茶产于温州平阳县，是浙江唯一的传统黄茶品类。平阳黄汤在清代与霍山黄芽齐名。闷黄工艺赋予其独特"黄汤黄叶"的品质特征。汤色杏黄明亮，香气甜醇，滋味甘爽。获国家地理标志保护。

title: Pingyang Huangtang Yellow Tea
summary: Pingyang Huangtang Yellow Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 瑶溪皇糖茶
summary: 瑶溪皇糖茶是温州永嘉县恢复的古老黄茶品种,历史上称"温州黄汤"。兼具绿茶的鲜爽和黄茶的醇和,汤色杏黄如蜜,滋味甘甜如糖,是黄茶中的稀有珍品。

title: Yaoxi Huangtang Yellow Tea
summary: Yaoxi Huangtang Yellow Tea is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 开化龙顶
summary: 开化龙顶产于钱江源头——开化县。这里是浙江母亲河钱塘江的源头,生态环境居浙江之冠(钱江源国家森林公园)。外形紧直挺秀,白毫显露如龙须。冲泡后香气清高鲜灵,滋味鲜醇甘爽。开化龙顶是钱江源头生态优越的物证——每一杯茶都在诉说"好山好水出好茶"的真理。

title: Kaihua Longding Green Tea (Zhejiang)
summary: Kaihua Longding Green Tea (Zhejiang) is a specific tea. Read it through type, cultivar, region, process and batch; a name or a broad label cannot explain the cup.

title: 哥伦比亚 Bitaco 红茶（Colombian Black Tea）
summary: “哥伦比亚高地红茶”不是一个受保护产区名，也不是全国统一的茶类等级；公开面能落到实处的，是 Agrícola Himalaya 在考卡山谷省 Bitaco 一带生产的 Bitaco 黑茶产品线。官方页面把它描述为有机、单一产地精品茶，黑茶汤色琥珀，口感顺滑、微甜、柔和，带葡萄干和西梅干似的甜果香。茶园海拔约 1,800 米，与 Bitaco 区域森林保护区共存；品牌前身是 Té Hindú，2016 年才转为 Bitaco 精品有机线。品种、具体氧化与揉捻参数官方没有公开，不能补写。

title: Bitaco Colombian Black Tea
titleAlt: 哥伦比亚 Bitaco 红茶（Colombian Black Tea）
summary: “Colombian highland black tea” is neither a protected appellation nor a national grade. The public, traceable object is the Bitaco black-tea line made by Agrícola Himalaya in the Bitaco area of Valle del Cauca, Colombia. Bitaco describes its black teas as organic, single-origin specialty tea with an amber liquor, smooth and subtly sweet, mellow, with raisin and dried-plum notes. The garden sits at about 1,800 metres and coexists with the Bitaco Regional Forest Reserve. The company's earlier commodity brand was Té Hindú; Bitaco was launched in 2016 as a premium organic line. Cultivar, oxidation percentage and rolling method are not published, so this page does not invent them.

title: 比塔科绿茶（Bitaco Unique Colombian Tea）
summary: 比塔科（Bitaco）是哥伦比亚 Agrícola Himalaya S.A. 的精品茶品牌，产自考卡山谷省 La Cumbre 的 Hacienda Himalaya，是哥伦比亚唯一的商业茶园。庄园约 254 公顷，海拔约 1,700–2,050 米，约一半是保护林、一半是有机茶园。它的绿茶不是日式蒸青：公开可核实的一款 Selva Curly Green 为 pan-fired（炒青/烘青风格），风味偏甜、坚果、柔和，而不是海苔鲜豆。旧稿的“1998 年日本蒸青线、Yabukita/Asatsuyu 品种、JAS 认证、安第斯玉露”没有来源，已删除或降级。

title: Bitaco Green Tea
titleAlt: 比塔科绿茶（Bitaco Unique Colombian Tea）
summary: Bitaco is the specialty tea brand of Agrícola Himalaya S.A., grown at Hacienda Himalaya in La Cumbre, Bitaco, Valle del Cauca, Colombia. The estate is about 254 ha at roughly 1,700–2,050 m, with about half conservation forest and half organic tea, and is described by its owner as Colombia's only commercial tea plantation. Its green tea is not Japanese steamed tea: a publicly verifiable Bitaco green, Selva Curly Green, is pan-fired, with a sweet, nutty, mellow profile rather than a marine sencha profile. The old draft's "1998 Japanese steaming line," "Yabukita/Asatsuyu cultivars," "JAS certification" and "Andean gyokuro" claims have no source and have been removed.

title: 阿萨姆红茶
summary: 阿萨姆红茶产于印度东北部布拉马普特拉河谷，是世界上面积最大的连片茶区。它以浓强、麦芽甜和深琥珀色茶汤著称，既是英式早餐茶的核心拼配原料，也有少量传统 Orthodox 全叶茶供单品饮用。

title: Assam Tea
summary: Assam is the world’s largest contiguous tea-growing region, producing bold, malty black tea on the Brahmaputra plains; CTC is its everyday volume tea, while orthodox Assam offers a fuller-leaf alternative.

title: 大吉岭初摘
summary: 大吉岭初摘是每年 2 月下旬至 4 月中旬采摘的春茶，茶汤浅亮、香气清鲜，带花香、青草和柑橘调。它工艺上仍属红茶，但发酵很轻，风格接近轻发酵茶，适合清饮和低温快出。

title: Darjeeling First Flush
summary: First flush is Darjeeling’s late-February to mid-April spring picking: light, bright and floral, made as a black tea but with very little oxidation, so it drinks closer to a lightly oxidised tea than a classic red cup.

title: 大吉岭月光茶
summary: “Moonlight”是大吉岭的一种特种茶名，通常指用早春嫩芽、嫩叶做成的低氧化白茶，也偶尔指同名的初摘红茶。它不是茶树品种、不是庄园名，也不是受保护的等级；“月圆夜采摘”更多是传统叙事和营销语言，不能当成所有 Moonlight 的硬标准。买之前要问清楚：哪个庄园、哪一季、白茶还是红茶、什么品种。

title: Darjeeling Moonlight
summary: “Moonlight” is a specialty tea name in Darjeeling, usually used for a low-oxidation white tea made from tender spring buds and young leaves, and occasionally for a first-flush black or lightly oxidised lot. It is not a cultivar, an estate name or a protected grade. The full-moon picking story is tradition and marketing, not a rule that applies to every Moonlight.

title: 大吉岭麝香葡萄
summary: “麝香葡萄”不是大吉岭的一个茶类或品种，而是对一种类似熟白葡萄、蜂蜜与花香的复合风味的描述，最常出现在次摘。它不能被保证，也不能靠香精复制；判断时要看香气是否自然、茶汤是否有骨架。

title: Darjeeling Muscatel
summary: Muscatel is not a tea type or cultivar but a tasting term for a ripe-grape, honey and floral note, most often found in Darjeeling second flush; it cannot be guaranteed and should not be confused with added grape flavour.

title: 大吉岭次摘
summary: 大吉岭次摘在每年 5–6 月采摘，叶片带紫铜色光泽，茶汤比初摘更饱满，香气以麝香葡萄、熟果和蜂蜜调为主，是大吉岭最广为认可的经典风格。

title: Darjeeling Second Flush
summary: Second flush is Darjeeling’s May–June picking, with purplish leaf, a fuller amber liquor and the muscatel, ripe-fruit and honey notes that made the region famous.

title: 大吉岭红茶
summary: 大吉岭红茶产于印度西孟加拉邦大吉岭县喜马拉雅南麓，海拔约 600–2000 米，以清雅花果香、明亮汤色和细腻口感著称。它受印度地理标志与证明商标双重保护，只有产自登记茶园的百分之百大吉岭茶才能使用官方标志。

title: Darjeeling Tea
summary: Darjeeling grows at 600–2,000 m in the Himalayan foothills and is protected by an Indian GI and certification marks; its teas are floral, bright and delicate, with first, second, monsoon and autumn flushes offering distinct styles.

title: 尼尔吉里红茶
summary: 尼尔吉里红茶产于印度南部泰米尔纳德邦的蓝山高原，海拔约 1000–2500 米，受西南与东北两股季风影响，几乎全年可采。它以清雅花香、金黄汤色、明亮活泼的口感和顺滑的奶感著称，与阿萨姆的浓强路线相反。

title: Nilgiri Tea
summary: Nilgiri tea grows at 1,000–2,500 m in southern India’s Blue Mountains, where two monsoons allow near year-round plucking; it is floral, golden and brisk, with a creamy texture rather than Assam’s malt-heavy strength.

title: 甘邦绿茶（Gamboeng Green Tea Peko Super）
summary: 甘邦绿茶在公开面上对应的是印尼茶叶与金鸡纳研究所（PPTK）的 **Gamboeng Green Tea Peko Super**，不是一个“甘邦村”的泛称，也不是茶树品种。官方产品页把它定义为 Grade I 绿茶：原料为 Assamica 与 Sinensis 的嫩梢 p+1、b+1m，成茶圆卷、绿亮，涩感清爽，带天然烘焙香，汤色黄绿；实验室测得总多酚 21–21.5%。建议 2–3 克/150–200 毫升、70–80°C、2–3 分钟。Gambung 茶园在 Ciwidey、Bandung 一带，约 600 公顷，大部分种茶，其余为天然林。

title: Gambung Green Tea (Gamboeng Peko Super)
titleAlt: 甘邦绿茶（Gamboeng Green Tea Peko Super）
summary: Gambung Green Tea, in the public record, is the PPTK product **Gamboeng Green Tea Peko Super** — not a generic “Gambung village” tea and not a cultivar. PPTK's official page defines it as a Grade I green tea made from young Assamica and Sinensis shoots picked to the p+1 and b+1m standards. The leaf is round-rolled and glossy green, the taste is refreshingly astringent, the aroma has a natural roasted note, the liquor is yellow-green, and the laboratory total polyphenol figure is 21–21.5%. The official brewing suggestion is 2–3 g per 150–200 ml at 70–80°C for 2–3 minutes. Gambung itself is a roughly 600-hectare estate in Ciwidey, Bandung Regency, most of it tea and the rest natural forest.

title: 葛林芝茶（凯尤阿罗红茶）
summary: 葛林芝茶通常指苏门答腊占碑省葛林芝（Kerinci）一带的红茶，核心是凯尤阿罗（Kayu Aro）茶园与茶厂。茶园在葛林芝火山西侧山腰，主流资料给出的高度约 1,600 米；茶厂 1925 年由荷兰 NV HVA 建立，1930 年代初投产，现由 PTPN IV PalmCo 管理，生产 orthodox 与 CTC 红茶。旧稿说“印尼最高、最大、山顶积雪”，这些说法要纠正：葛林芝火山高 3,805 米，但地处赤道，没有终年积雪；茶园也不在 3,805 米。

title: Kerinci Tea (Kayu Aro Black Tea)
titleAlt: 葛林芝茶（凯尤阿罗红茶）
summary: Kerinci tea usually means black tea from the Kerinci district of Jambi, Sumatra, and its core is the Kayu Aro garden and factory. The main garden sits at about 1,600 m on the western slope of Mount Kerinci; the factory was built in 1925 by the Dutch company NV HVA, began formal production in the early 1930s, and is now managed by PTPN IV PalmCo. It makes both orthodox and CTC black tea. The old draft called it Indonesia’s highest and largest tea region and described snow on a 3,805 m summit. Mount Kerinci is 3,805 m, but it is equatorial and has no permanent snow; the tea garden is nowhere near the summit.

title: 马拉巴山茶（Malabar Tea Estate）
summary: 马拉巴山茶指的是西爪哇 Pangalengan 的 Malabar Tea Estate，不是一种独立的茶树品种，也不是“山顶茶园”的泛称。庄园由 Karel Albert Rudolf Bosscha 于 1896 年开辟，现由 PTPN I Regional 2 管理；2003 年公开报道写面积约 1,300 公顷，2025 年官方资料写茶树在海拔 1,400–1,600 米，采用 fine plucking（一芽二叶）手采，主产 Leafy Grade Premium OP FO 条索红茶。它的风味是花香、浓厚汤体，2025 年首次出口台湾，潜在年采购量 42 吨。旧稿的“百年老丛、火山石窖藏、地热矿物暖流”等细节没有可靠来源，已删除或降级。

title: Malabar Tea Estate (Pangalengan, West Java)
summary: "Malabar Mountain Tea" refers to the Malabar Tea Estate in Pangalengan, West Java, not a separate cultivar and not a generic "mountain garden." The estate was opened by Karel Albert Rudolf Bosscha in 1896 and is now managed by PTPN I Regional 2. A 2003 report gives an area of about 1,300 ha; a 2025 official source puts the tea at 1,400–1,600 m, hand-picked by fine plucking (two leaves and a bud), and identifies Leafy Grade Premium OP FO as the representative black tea. Its flavour is floral with a strong body, and its first export to Taiwan in 2025 came with a potential 42 t/year purchase interest. The old draft's century-old bushes, volcanic-stone cellar and geothermal-mineral story had no reliable source and have been removed.

title: 帕潘达扬白茶（加鲁特高山白茶）
titleAlt: Papandayan White Tea (Garut Highland White Tea)
summary: 帕潘达扬白茶是本站对印度尼西亚西爪哇加鲁特（Garut）高地产白茶的区域称呼，不是注册产区，也不是单一庄园品牌。可以核实的是：加鲁特高地有茶农 Dasep Badrusalam（Mooi Tea House / Teh Nyaneut）生产白茶，清晨 05:30–07:30 采芽；PTPN VIII 在加鲁特有一个名为 Papandayan 的茶园，但现有资料说它生产红茶。旧稿把两者合并成“帕潘达扬火山南坡 1,600–1,800 米、全印尼只此一家白茶微型庄园”，并编出创始人、品种和奖项；这些说法没有来源，本站只保留区域定义和证据边界。

title: Papandayan White Tea (Garut Highland White Tea)
titleAlt: 帕潘达扬白茶（加鲁特高山白茶）
summary: Papandayan white tea is this site’s regional label for white tea from the Garut highlands of West Java, Indonesia. It is not a registered origin and not a single-estate brand. What can be verified: a Garut highland producer, Dasep Badrusalam of Mooi Tea House / Teh Nyaneut, made white tea and picked buds only between 05:30 and 07:30; and PTPN VIII operates a tea estate called Papandayan in Garut, but the source describes it as a black-tea estate. The old draft merged the two into “the only white-tea micro-estate on Papandayan’s southern slope at 1,600–1,800 m” and invented a founder, cultivar and awards. Those claims have no source and are not retained.

title: 玉露
summary: 玉露是采摘前遮光约20天、蒸青后揉捻做形的日本绿茶；低温冲泡才能带出鲜甜与海苔香，高温会把苦涩一起拉出来。

title: Gyokuro
summary: Gyokuro is Japanese green tea shaded for about twenty days before picking, then steamed and rolled; cool water and a generous leaf ratio produce its dense umami and marine sweetness.

title: 焙茶
summary: 焙茶是把煎茶、番茶或茶梗经过高温焙火制成的日本茶；茶汤琥珀色、香气像烤坚果与焦糖，咖啡因相对较低，适合午后与餐后。

title: Hojicha
summary: Hojicha is Japanese green tea roasted after processing; the leaf turns brown, the liquor becomes amber, and the aroma moves from fresh grass to toasted nuts and caramel.

title: 釜炒茶
summary: 釜炒茶（kamairicha）是日本用热铁釜或炒锅杀青、而非蒸汽杀青的绿茶类别。鲜叶在约 300–400°C 的铁釜中翻炒，杀青后揉捻、干燥；因为不做精揉，成品常呈勾玉状弯卷。主要产地为宫崎、佐贺、大分、熊本等地。日本茶业中央会 2026 年资料称宫崎县釜炒茶产量全国第一（1,110 公顷、2,880 吨），全国茶园 33,400 公顷、荒茶 75,100 吨；五ヶ瀬 GIAHS 资料称釜炒茶占日本茶不到 1%。釜炒茶有釜香（kamaka）、黄金色茶汤、较低苦涩和烘焙甜感，但它不是焙茶（hojicha），也不等于中国炒青绿茶。

title: Kamairicha
summary: Kamairicha is a Japanese green-tea category defined by pan-firing rather than steaming. Fresh leaves are tossed in a hot iron kettle or pan at about 300–400°C, then rolled and dried; because the leaves are not given the final needle-straightening pass, the finished tea often curls into a magatama-like shape. The main producing areas are Miyazaki, Saga, Oita and Kumamoto. The Japan Tea Central Association's 2026 data puts Miyazaki first in kamairicha output, with 1,110 ha of tea and 2,880 tonnes of aracha; nationally there are 33,400 ha of tea and 75,100 tonnes of aracha. The Gokase GIAHS page says kamairicha accounts for less than 1% of Japanese tea. It has a kettle aroma (kamaka), a clear golden liquor, lower astringency and a roasted-sweet finish, but it is not hojicha and not the same thing as Chinese pan-fired green tea.

title: 藏出抹茶
summary: 藏出抹茶不是茶树品种，也不是“越老越好”的年份茶。它指春季制成的碾茶被密封进茶壺、在低温避光中越过夏天，到十一月“口切”时才取出研磨的抹茶；时间改变的是涩感与旨味的平衡，不是把绿茶变成另一种东西。

title: Kuradashi Matcha
summary: Kuradashi matcha is neither a cultivar nor a “older is better” vintage tea. It is tencha made in spring, sealed in a tea jar, kept cool and dark through the summer, then opened and ground at kuchikiri in November. Time softens astringency and shifts umami forward; it does not turn green tea into something else.

title: 抹茶
summary: 抹茶是遮光栽培的碾茶经石磨或细磨制成的粉末绿茶；它的关键是遮光、蒸青、不揉与研磨，而不是“把绿茶磨成粉”。

title: Matcha
summary: Matcha is a powdered green tea made from shade-grown tencha; the defining steps are shading, steaming, not rolling, and fine milling, not simply grinding any green tea into powder.

title: 煎茶
summary: 煎茶是日本产量最大的绿茶，蒸青后揉捻做形；茶汤黄绿、带青草与海苔香，70–80°C冲泡最能平衡鲜味与涩味。

title: Sencha
summary: Sencha is Japan’s most-produced green tea: steamed, rolled and dried leaf with a fresh marine aroma, brewed around 70–80°C to balance umami and astringency.

title: 碾茶
summary: 碾茶是遮光栽培、蒸青、不揉、干燥后的抹茶原料；它不直接磨粉，也不是普通绿茶，读它要抓住“遮光、不揉、去梗去脉”三个关键词。

title: Tencha
summary: Tencha is the shade-grown, steamed, unrolled and de-veined leaf from which matcha is milled; the defining steps are shading, no rolling and leaf-flesh separation.

title: 宇治抹茶
summary: 宇治抹茶是宇治茶区与抹茶工艺结合的名称；读它要同时看产地、遮光栽培、碾茶加工与品牌，而不是把“宇治”当成一个品质形容词。

title: Uji Matcha
summary: Uji matcha is matcha from the Uji tea area and tradition; read it through origin, shade cultivation, tencha processing and brand, not as a quality adjective attached to any green powder.

title: 八女玉露
summary: 八女玉露是福冈县八女地区出产的玉露，核心产区在黑木町、上阳町、星野村一带。它和宇治玉露一样属于遮光绿茶，但八女更强调稻秸秆覆盖、手摘和传统本玉露的 GI 规范。不要把“手摘”误写成“手揉”：手揉茶是另一项独立传统工艺，不是八女玉露的常规做法。

title: Yame Gyokuro
summary: Yame gyokuro is gyokuro produced in the Yame region of Fukuoka Prefecture, with Kuroki, Kamitsuyo and Hoshino as core districts. Like Uji gyokuro, it is a shade-grown green tea, but Yame emphasises rice-straw shading, hand picking and the narrower GI-protected name Yame Dento Hon Gyokuro. “Hand-picked” is not the same as “hand-rolled”: hand-rolled tea is a separate craft, not the standard gyokuro process.

title: 八女抹茶
summary: 八女抹茶是福冈县八女地区出产的抹茶，属于“产地 + 茶类”的组合，不是茶树品种，也不是一个受保护的等级。八女在日本更出名的是玉露；抹茶和碾茶是当地另一条产品线。它的风格通常被描述为旨味厚、甜感足、苦味相对低，但具体仍取决于品种、遮光和研磨方式。

title: Yame Matcha
summary: Yame matcha is matcha made from tea grown and processed in the Yame region of Fukuoka Prefecture. It is a place-plus-style name, not a cultivar or a protected grade. Yame is better known for gyokuro; matcha and tencha are a separate line from the same region. The style is usually described as deep in umami, sweet and relatively low in bitterness, but the details depend on cultivar, shading and milling.

title: 古兰瑟茶（Guranse）
summary: 古兰瑟（Guranse）是尼泊尔东部丹库塔县 Hile 一带的茶园与公司名，不是茶类名，也不是受保护产区。茶园约 290 公顷，海拔约 1,000–2,200 米，1990年代中后期由 Vaidya 家族从零建立，现有 600 多户合作农户，主做 orthodox 条索茶与白茶、乌龙、绿茶等特种茶。它的核心风味是 muscatel（麝香葡萄香），一年分春、夏、季风、秋四次采摘。旧稿把它写成“1934 年 Rana 王子庄园、荷兰-尼泊尔合资、古树 clone”，这些说法没有可靠来源，已删除。

title: Guranse Tea Estate (Hile, Dhankuta)
summary: Guranse is the name of a tea estate and company in Hile, Dhankuta, eastern Nepal, not a tea type and not a protected appellation. The garden is about 290 ha, spans roughly 1,000–2,200 m, was built in the mid-to-late 1990s by the Vaidya family, and works with more than 600 local farming households. It makes orthodox black tea plus white, oolong and green specialty teas. Its signature black-tea flavour is muscatel, and it picks four main flushes a year. The old draft's "1934 Rana prince estate," "Dutch-Nepali joint venture" and "ancient-tree clone" stories have no reliable source and have been removed.

title: 军恰巴里（月光茶园）
summary: 军恰巴里（Jun Chiyabari）是尼泊尔东部丹库塔 Hile 一带的家族有机茶园和品牌，2000 年成立，2001 年购地开园，现有约 90 公顷，海拔 1,650–2,200 米。园名在尼泊尔语中意为“月光茶园”。创始人是 Bachan 和 Lochan Gyawali 兄弟，不是旧稿写的“日本设计师 Toshi Bhandari”；茶园自首次种植起按有机方式管理，2012 年 8 月获 IMO 瑞士有机认证。产品覆盖黑、白、乌龙、绿茶，Himalayan Bouquet 是东亚乌龙风格。旧稿的“日本设计师、巴黎金奖、六月茶园”等说法，未见于园方年表或公开访谈，本站已删。

title: Jun Chiyabari (Moon-lit Tea Garden)
summary: Jun Chiyabari is a family-owned organic tea garden and brand in Hile, Dhankuta, eastern Nepal. It was established in 2000, bought its first land in 2001, and now farms about 90 ha at roughly 1,650–2,200 m. The name means “Moon-lit Tea Garden” in Nepali. The founders are Bachan and Lochan Gyawali, not the “Japanese designer Toshi Bhandari” of the old draft. The garden has been organic since first planting and received IMO Switzerland certification in August 2012. It makes black, white, oolong and green tea; Himalayan Bouquet is its East Asian oolong style. The old draft’s Japanese-designer, Paris-gold-medal and “June tea garden” claims are not supported by the garden’s own timeline or published interviews and have been removed.

title: Kanyam Tea Estate（卡尼亚姆茶园）
summary: Kanyam Tea Estate 是尼泊尔伊拉姆县的一座茶园，隶属尼泊尔茶叶发展公司（NTDC），现由 Triveni 集团经营。NTDC 官方称它是“所有茶园中的女王”，茶厂海拔 5,500 英尺（约 1,676 米），是伊拉姆县海拔最高的茶园；茶园总面积约 216 公顷，其中 200 公顷种茶，年产约 250,000 公斤 orthodox 茶；距印度大吉岭茶园约 2 公里，位于干城章嘉峰山麓。官方材料说它是在已故国王比兰德拉推动下、与英国技术合作建立的，但没有给出精确建园年份。Kanyam 是茶园和产地名，不是单一零售品牌，也不是茶树品种；官方也没有给出品种、等级、价格、有机认证或具体感官描述。

title: Kanyam Tea Estate
titleAlt: Kanyam Tea Estate（卡尼亚姆茶园）
summary: Kanyam Tea Estate is a tea garden in Ilam, Nepal, owned by the Nepal Tea Development Corporation (NTDC) and now operated by the Triveni Group. NTDC calls it the “Queen of all Tea Gardens”. Its factory sits at 5,500 ft (about 1,676 m), and NTDC describes the garden as the highest in Ilam district; the estate covers about 216 ha, of which 200 ha are planted to tea, and produces about 250,000 kg of orthodox tea a year. It lies in the foothills of Kanchenjunga, about 2 km from the Darjeeling tea gardens. NTDC says the garden was established with British technical collaboration at the initiative of the late King Birendra, but it gives no exact planting year. Kanyam is a garden and place name, not a single retail brand or a tea cultivar; the official material does not give a cultivar, grade, price, organic certification or specific sensory profile.

title: 尼泊尔金毫
summary: 尼泊尔金毫是尼泊尔东部高山茶区的一种金毫红茶风格，不是受保护的产区名，也不是单一茶树品种。“Golden Tips”在不同茶庄可以指全芽，也可以指一芽一叶；共同点是芽头多、干茶显金黄毫、汤色琥珀，风味偏蜂蜜、麦芽、坚果和熟果。买的时候要问清采摘季、芽叶标准和具体茶园。

title: Nepal Golden Tips
summary: Nepal Golden Tips is a style of golden-tippy black tea from the eastern highlands, not a protected origin or a single cultivar. “Golden Tips” may mean an all-bud pick or a one-leaf-and-a-bud pick, depending on the maker. The common thread is a high proportion of buds, a golden dry leaf, an amber cup and honey-malt flavors. Ask for the plucking standard, harvest and garden, not just the name.

title: Kanchanjangha Verde（尼泊尔高山有机绿茶）
summary: Kanchanjangha Verde 是尼泊尔潘奇塔尔（Panchthar）的 Kanchanjangha Tea Estate and Research Center（KTERC）生产的一款高山有机绿茶，也被称为 Kanchanjangha Verde（Himalayan Mist）。KTERC 1984 年建立，是尼泊尔第一个获认证的有机茶园；95 公顷茶园位于干城章嘉山麓，官网给出 800–2,300 米与 1,300–1,800 米两组海拔口径。鲜叶手工采摘，短暂摊放后快速干燥停止氧化，揉捻、静置、复干、破碎筛分，再手工分级，工艺接近大吉岭山区经典绿茶。

title: Kanchanjangha Verde
titleAlt: Kanchanjangha Verde（尼泊尔高山有机绿茶）
summary: Kanchanjangha Verde is a high-mountain organic green tea made by the Kanchanjangha Tea Estate and Research Center (KTERC) in Panchthar, eastern Nepal. It is also sold as Kanchanjangha Verde (Himalayan Mist). KTERC was founded in 1984 and describes itself as Nepal's first certified organic tea garden; its 95-hectare estate sits in the foothills of Kanchenjunga, with the estate's own materials giving two altitude ranges, 800–2,300 m for the whole property and 1,300–1,800 m for the main garden. The leaf is hand-plucked, briefly rested, quickly dried to stop oxidation, rolled, rested, re-dried, crushed and machine-sorted, then hand-graded. The method is close to classic green tea from the Darjeeling Hills.

title: 尼泊尔乌龙
summary: 尼泊尔乌龙是尼泊尔东部山区出产的部分氧化茶，主要产区在伊拉姆、丹库塔、潘奇塔尔一带，常见海拔约 1,200–2,100 米。它是一个风格类别，不是受保护产区，也不是单一品种：氧化度可从约 20% 到 80%，风味从轻花香到重氧化的坚果、石果。旧稿把“沙达普、金萱/青心乌龙、雪山乌龙、世界最高”写成统一事实；这些说法只适用于个别茶园，不能代表整个尼泊尔乌龙。

title: Nepal Oolong Tea
summary: Nepal oolong is a partially oxidised tea made in the eastern hills of Nepal, mainly around Ilam, Dhankuta and Panchthar, at roughly 1,200–2,100 m. It is a style category, not a protected appellation and not a single cultivar: oxidation can range from about 20% to 80%, and flavour from light floral to nutty, stone-fruit and darker profiles. The old draft turned “Sundarpani”, Jinxuan/Qingxin, “snow-mountain oolong” and “world’s highest” into national facts. Those claims apply, at most, to individual gardens and do not define Nepal oolong.

title: 尼泊尔白茶（东部山区小批量白茶）
summary: 尼泊尔白茶通常指尼泊尔东部山区小批量制作的白茶或轻氧化茶，核心在伊拉姆、丹库塔、潘切塔尔一带。它不是受保护产区，也没有官方“白茶”统计类目，更不是单一品种或单一茶园的产品。公开可核实的做法至少有两类：单芽或一芽一叶长时萎凋后低温干燥的银针式；以及一芽一叶轻揉 8–10 分钟后干燥的“银乌龙”式。旧稿把尼泊尔白茶写成“全国统一不炒不揉不发酵”、只有一个核心山谷，这两个简化都不成立。

title: Nepal White Tea
titleAlt: 尼泊尔白茶（东部山区小批量白茶）
summary: Nepal white tea is best understood as a small-batch style from the eastern hills, not a protected appellation and not a single garden. The core districts are Ilam, Dhankuta and Panchthar. Publicly verifiable production falls into at least two families: a pure withered-and-dried silver-needle style, and a lightly rolled style such as KTERC's White Prakash, which is rolled for 8–10 minutes and sold as a "Silvery Oolong." The old draft's claim that all Nepali white tea is unrolled, unoxidised and from one valley does not hold.

title: 金海将军茶（Gimhae Janggun-cha）
summary: 金海将军茶是韩国庆尚南道金海市的地方传统茶，不是一个泛称的“金海绿茶”。它以大叶、厚叶的当地茶树群体为原料，主要做成不发酵绿茶，也有发酵（氧化）茶产品；名字来自高丽忠烈王赐名“将军”的记载，更早的源头则被地方叙述追溯到公元 48 年伽耶王妃许黄玉从印度携来茶种。金海市从 1999 年起推动复原，野生茶树群落分布在分城山山麓的东上、大成一带。官方资料强调它耐 100°C 高温、香气像野蔷薇、回甘明显；旧稿的 1992 年稻田改茶园、1995 年试制、1998 年茶农协会、2005 年有机认证、200–300 吨产量、30% 市场份额、Yabukita 和龙王传说都没有可核实来源，不能保留。

title: Gimhae Janggun-cha (Janggun Tea)
summary: Gimhae Janggun-cha is a local tea from Gimhae, Gyeongsangnam-do, South Korea, not a generic “Gimhae green tea.” It is made from a large, thick-leaf local tea population, primarily as non-fermented green tea but also as an oxidised product. The name is tied to a recorded Goryeo-era story in which King Chungnyeol gave the tea the title “Janggun” (general); an older local tradition traces the plants to Queen Heo Hwang-ok and seeds brought from India in AD 48. Gimhae has promoted the tea since 1999, with wild tea clusters on the slopes of Bunseongsan. Official material describes a tea that holds up to 100°C water, has a wild-rose-like aroma and a sweet umami finish. The old draft's 1992/1995/1998/2005 timeline, 200–300 tonne output, 30% market share, Yabukita and dragon-king legend had no verifiable source and were removed.

title: 河东绿茶（Hadong Green Tea）
summary: 河东绿茶是韩国庆尚南道河东郡的地理标志绿茶产区，不是单一品牌。官方口径称河东自新罗兴德王时期（828 年）由大廉公从唐带回茶种、王命种于智义山，至今约 1,200 年；2006 年被指定为“河东野生茶产业特区”，2015 年入选韩国重要农业遗产（KIAHS），2017 年入选 FAO 全球重要农业文化遗产（GIAHS）。2008 年官方统计为 2,100 户茶农、1,048 公顷、2,230 吨、261 亿韩元。它的核心工艺是韩国传统的“덖음”（deokkeum，反复炒制与揉捻），不是日本蒸青；茶园沿蟾津江与花开川分布，雾多、湿度高、昼夜温差大。旧稿的“中国小叶种后代”“智异香 Jirihyang”“1970 年代发现野生古茶树”“日据时期放弃机械化”等说法没有来源，已删除。

title: Hadong Green Tea
summary: Hadong green tea is a geographical-indication green tea region in Hadong County, South Korea, not a single brand. Official material dates the beginning to 828, when Kim Daeryeom returned from Tang China with tea seeds and the king ordered them planted on Jirisan; the county describes about 1,200 years of tea history and calls itself the first tea cultivation site. Hadong was designated a wild tea industrial special district in 2006, a Korean Important Agricultural Heritage (KIAHS) in 2015 and a FAO Globally Important Agricultural Heritage System (GIAHS) in 2017. The 2008 official count was 2,100 tea households, 1,048 ha, 2,230 tonnes and KRW 26.1 billion. Its signature process is *deokkeum*, repeated pan-firing and rubbing, not Japanese steaming; the tea fields run along the Seomjin River and Hwagae Stream, with fog, high humidity and a wide day–night temperature range. Old claims about a “Chinese small-leaf descendant,” “Jirihyang,” wild tea trees “discovered in the 1970s” and a Japanese-colonial break in mechanisation have no source and are removed.

title: 韩国黄茶（Hwangcha）
summary: Hwangcha（황차）是韩国的部分氧化茶，不是中国黄茶“闷黄”工艺的同义词。韩国茶企 Hankook Tea 的官方科普把它写作 partially oxidized，氧化度约 50–80%，采用 pan-fired 杀青；其产品页又把一款春季 Hwang Cha Gold 标为 Sejak 等级，原料来自湖南（Honam）茶园的传统实生种 jae-rae-jong。茶汤偏琥珀色，口感顺滑，风格介于绿茶与红茶之间。它不是“韩国黄茶唯一代表”，也不是中国黄茶的子类。

title: Hwangcha (Korean Partially Oxidised Tea)
summary: Hwangcha (황차) is a Korean partially oxidised tea, not a synonym for Chinese yellow tea and its menhuang / sealed-yellow process. Hankook Tea's official tea guide puts hwangcha at roughly 50–80% oxidation and describes it as pan-fired, with a production cycle of about two to three days. Its Hwang Cha Gold product is an early-spring, Sejak-grade tea from the company's Honam gardens, made from traditional jae-rae-jong seed-grown material; the liquor is amber and smooth, sitting between green tea and black tea. The name “yellow tea” describes colour and market usage, not the Chinese yellow-tea process.

title: 济州绿茶
summary: 济州绿茶首先是一个产地名称，不是单一品种或等级。它指济州岛出产的绿茶；今天最常被提到的是西归浦的西广、Dolsongi 与 Hannam 三块有机茶园，石头地开垦、汉拏山云雾与品牌化管理共同构成它的产地形象。

title: Jeju Green Tea
summary: Jeju green tea is a place name, not a cultivar or a grade. It means green tea grown and processed on Jeju Island; the best-documented examples come from the organic fields at Seogwang, Dolsongi and Hannam, where stone clearing, cloud cover from Hallasan and brand-scale farming shape the origin image.

title: 韩国抹茶
summary: 韩国抹茶（말차）是用遮阴栽培的绿茶鲜叶，经蒸青、干燥、去梗后研磨成的细粉。主要产区在宝城、河东和济州；河东近年把“河东抹茶”作为出口与品牌重点。它和日本抹茶工艺同源，但茶树品种、遮阴时长、研磨细度和风味风格不同，不能简单说成“日本抹茶”。

title: Korean Matcha
summary: Korean matcha (말차) is finely milled green tea made from shaded leaves, steamed, dried and de-veined. Boseong, Hadong and Jeju are the main districts.
